questions.prompt: Mean' Joe Greene was a 2x NFL DPOY, drafted in 1969 out of this Texas college town
questions.promptZh: “Mean Joe” Greene 曾两获 NFL 年度最佳防守球员，1969 年从这座德州大学城被选中
questions.story: Charles "Mean" Joe Greene was born in Temple, Texas, and played college football at North Texas State University in Denton before the Pittsburgh Steelers drafted him in 1969. He won two NFL Defensive Player of the Year awards.
questions.storyZh: 查尔斯·“Mean Joe”·格林出生于德州坦普尔，在丹顿的北德克萨斯州立大学打大学橄榄球，1969 年被匹兹堡钢人队选中，曾两次荣膺 NFL 年度最佳防守球员。

questions.prompt: Because of his father's basketball career, Ravens safety Kyle Hamilton was born on this Mediterranean island's capital
questions.promptZh: 由于父亲的篮球生涯，Ravens 安全卫凯尔·汉密尔顿出生在这座地中海岛屿的首府
questions.story: Kyle Hamilton, a safety for the Baltimore Ravens, was born on March 16, 2001, in Heraklion, the capital of the Greek island of Crete, where his father Derrick Hamilton played professional basketball.
questions.storyZh: 巴尔的摩乌鸦队安全卫凯尔·汉密尔顿于2001年3月16日出生在希腊克里特岛首府伊拉克利翁；他的父亲德里克·汉密尔顿曾在此打职业篮球。

questions.prompt: After jail time in 1995 and 1996, Randy Moss revived his career at Marshall and was drafted by the Vikings here in 1998
questions.promptZh: 兰迪·莫斯在1995和1996年两度服刑后，于 Marshall 重振生涯，并在1998年被这里的维京人队选中
questions.story: Randy Moss served three days in jail in 1995 and another 60 days in 1996 for a probation violation before reviving his career at Marshall. The Minnesota Vikings drafted him 21st overall in 1998.
questions.storyZh: 兰迪·莫斯1995年服刑3天，1996年因违反缓刑又服刑60天，之后在 Marshall 大学重振职业生涯，并在1998年选秀中以第21顺位被明尼苏达维京人队选中。

questions.prompt: Before becoming NFL quarterbacks, Carson Wentz and Trey Lance both won FCS national titles at this university
questions.promptZh: 在成为 NFL 四分卫之前，卡森·温茨和特雷·兰斯都在这所大学赢得 FCS 全国冠军
questions.story: Carson Wentz and Trey Lance both played quarterback at North Dakota State in Fargo, winning FCS national championships — Wentz in 2014 and 2015, Lance in 2018 and 2019 — before becoming first-round NFL draft picks.
questions.storyZh: 卡森·温茨和特雷·兰斯都曾在法戈的北达科他州立大学担任四分卫，分别赢得2014/2015和2018/2019年 FCS 全国冠军，之后都成为 NFL 首轮选秀球员。

questions.prompt: Bears QB Caleb Williams was born on November 18, 2001, in this US capital city
questions.promptZh: 熊队四分卫凯勒布·威廉姆斯2001年11月18日出生于华盛顿特区
questions.story: Caleb Williams was born in Washington, D.C., on November 18, 2001, and later became the Chicago Bears' starting quarterback.
questions.storyZh: 凯勒布·威廉姆斯2001年11月18日出生于华盛顿特区，后来成为芝加哥熊队的首发四分卫。

questions.prompt: From 2006 to 2014, the NFL Draft spent 9 straight years here before it hit the road
questions.promptZh: 从 2006 年到 2014 年，NFL 选秀连续 9 年在这里举行，之后开始异地举办
questions.story: The NFL held its annual draft in New York City for nine consecutive years from 2006 through 2014 before moving the event to Chicago in 2015.
questions.storyZh: NFL年度选秀自2006年至2014年连续九年在纽约市举行，随后于2015年移往芝加哥。

questions.prompt: Lamar Jackson became the youngest player ever to win the Heisman Trophy at this school
questions.promptZh: Lamar Jackson 在这所学校成为赢得 Heisman Trophy 的最年轻球员
questions.story: On December 10, 2016, Lamar Jackson became the youngest Heisman Trophy winner in history at 19 years and 337 days, playing for Louisville.
questions.storyZh: 2016年12月10日，路易斯维尔大学的拉马尔·杰克逊以19岁337天成为史上最年轻的海斯曼奖得主。

questions.prompt: Pat Tillman, who left the NFL to become an Army Ranger after 9/11, played college football in this city.
questions.promptZh: 9·11 后离开 NFL 加入陆军游骑兵的帕特·蒂尔曼，在这座城市读的大学橄榄球。
questions.story: Pat Tillman starred at Arizona State in Tempe before a four-year NFL career with the Cardinals; he enlisted in 2002 and was killed in Afghanistan in 2004.
questions.storyZh: 帕特·蒂尔曼在坦佩的亚利桑那州立大学成名，随后为红雀队效力四个赛季；2002 年入伍，2004 年在阿富汗阵亡。

questions.prompt: The NFL's smallest-market team played 2 to 3 home games a year from 1933 to 1994 in this nearby city to boost revenue
questions.promptZh: 这支 NFL 最小市场球队在1933至1994年间每年在这座邻近城市打2到3场主场比赛以增加收入
questions.story: The Green Bay Packers, the NFL's smallest-market team, played two or three home games a year at Milwaukee County Stadium from 1953 to 1994 before returning to Green Bay full-time.
questions.storyZh: NFL 最小市场球队绿湾包装工队1953至1994年间每年在密尔沃基县体育场打2到3个主场，之后全部回到绿湾。

questions.prompt: Adrian Peterson rushed for 1,925 yards as a 2004 freshman at this Big 12 school's town
questions.promptZh: Adrian Peterson 在 2004 年大一赛季便 rushing 了 1,925 码，当时效力于这所 Big 12 联盟学校所在的城市
questions.story: In 2004, Adrian Peterson rushed for 1,925 yards as a freshman at Baylor in Waco, launching a career that made him one of the NFL’s most accomplished runners.
questions.storyZh: 2004年，阿德里安·皮特森在沃科的贝勒大学以新生身份冲球1,925码，由此开启了他后来成为NFL杰出跑卫的生涯。

questions.prompt: Ashton Jeanty rushed for 2,601 yards and finished 2nd in Heisman voting while playing here
questions.promptZh: Ashton Jeanty 效力期间 rushing 了 2,601 码，并在 Heisman 评选中获得第二名
questions.story: In 2024, Ashton Jeanty rushed for 2,601 yards at Boise State and finished second in Heisman Trophy voting.
questions.storyZh: 2024年，阿什顿·金蒂在博伊西州立大学冲球2,601码，并获得海斯曼奖投票第二名。

questions.prompt: Before a 17-year NFL career, Ryan Fitzpatrick played quarterback at an Ivy League school in this city
questions.promptZh: 开启 17 年 NFL 生涯前，Ryan Fitzpatrick 曾在这座城市的常春藤盟校担任四分卫
questions.story: Before beginning a 17-season NFL career in 2003, Ryan Fitzpatrick was the quarterback at Cornell in Ithaca.
questions.storyZh: 在2003年开启长达17个赛季的NFL生涯前，瑞安·菲茨帕特里克曾是伊萨卡的康奈尔大学四分卫。

questions.prompt: This Midwestern city was where an NFL franchise began in 1919 as a starch company's works team
questions.promptZh: 1919年以迪凯特斯泰利队名义在这里成立的NFL球队，1921年迁往芝加哥
questions.story: The franchise was founded in Decatur, Illinois, in 1919 as a company team of the A.E. Staley starch business, becoming the Decatur Staleys before moving to Chicago in 1921.
questions.storyZh: 该球队1919年在伊利诺伊州迪凯特作为A.E.斯泰利淀粉公司的企业队成立，后称迪凯特斯泰利队，1921年迁至芝加哥。

questions.prompt: In 1999, Mike Ditka traded a historic 8-pick package to bring Ricky Williams to this city
questions.promptZh: 1999年，Mike Ditka 送出历史级的8号签位组合，将 Ricky Williams 带到这座城市
questions.story: In 1999, New Orleans Saints coach Mike Ditka traded eight draft picks to Baltimore for running back Ricky Williams, one of the franchise’s most consequential deals.
questions.storyZh: 1999年，新奥尔良圣徒队主教练迈克·迪特卡用8个选秀权从巴尔的摩换来跑卫里基·威廉姆斯，这成为球队史上最重大的交易之一。

questions.prompt: This city’s 1985 Bears recorded “The Super Bowl Shuffle” before winning Super Bowl XX.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市 1985 年的熊队在赢得第 20 届超级碗前录制了《超级碗摇摆舞》。
questions.story: The Chicago Bears’ 1985 charity single “The Super Bowl Shuffle” was released before their 46–10 win over the Patriots in Super Bowl XX.
questions.storyZh: 芝加哥熊队 1985 年的公益单曲《超级碗摇摆舞》在球队 46-10 击败爱国者赢得超级碗 XX 之前发行。

questions.prompt: Emmitt Smith, the NFL's all-time rushing leader, was born in this Florida city
questions.promptZh: NFL 历史冲球码王埃米特·史密斯出生在这座佛罗里达州城市
questions.story: Emmitt Smith was born in Pensacola, Florida, on May 15, 1969, and retired as the NFL's all-time leading rusher with 18,291 regular-season yards.
questions.storyZh: 埃米特·史密斯1969年5月15日出生于佛罗里达州彭萨科拉，退役时以18291码保持 NFL 常规赛历史冲球纪录。

questions.prompt: John Elway's 'The Drive' carried his team 98 yards to tie the 1987 AFC Championship in this city
questions.promptZh: 约翰·埃尔万的“The Drive”在这里带领丹佛推进98码追平1987年美联决赛
questions.story: On January 11, 1987, Elway led a 98-yard touchdown drive to tie the AFC Championship against Cleveland; Denver won 23–20 in overtime on a Rich Karlis field goal.
questions.storyZh: 1987年1月11日，埃尔万率队打出98码达阵推进追平美联决赛；丹佛最终在加时靠里奇·卡利斯的射门以23比20获胜。

questions.prompt: A Thanksgiving football game has been a long-running tradition for the franchise in this city since 1934
questions.promptZh: 自1934年起，这座城市的球队就有感恩节橄榄球赛的悠久传统
questions.story: The Detroit Lions first hosted a Thanksgiving Day game in 1934 and have played on the holiday in most years since, one of the NFL's longest-running traditions.
questions.storyZh: 底特律雄狮队1934年首次主办感恩节橄榄球赛，此后多数年份都在节日当天比赛，是 NFL 历史最悠久的传统之一。

questions.prompt: The “Fail Mary”, a replacement-ref call on the final play, decided a 2012 Monday Night game in this city.
questions.promptZh: 2012 年一场周一橄榄球之夜比赛的最后一攻由替补裁判的争议判罚“失败玛丽”定格在这座城市。
questions.story: On September 24, 2012, the Seahawks’ 14–12 win over the Packers ended with a disputed replacement-officials ruling on the final play — the “Fail Mary” — which helped end the referee lockout two days later.
questions.storyZh: 2012 年 9 月 24 日，海鹰队 14-12 战胜包装工队，最后一攻的替补裁判争议判罚被称为“失败玛丽”，两天后裁判停摆宣告结束。

questions.prompt: Super Bowl XVI, the first ever held in a cold-weather city, was played here at the Silverdome here in 1982
questions.promptZh: 1982年，首次在寒冷城市举行的 Super Bowl XVI 在这座城市的 Silverdome 举行
questions.story: Super Bowl XVI was played at the Silverdome in Pontiac on January 24, 1982, where the San Francisco 49ers beat the Cincinnati Bengals 26–21 — the first Super Bowl held in a cold-weather city.
questions.storyZh: 1982年1月24日，第十六届超级碗在庞蒂亚克银顶体育场举行，旧金山49人队以26比21击败辛辛那提孟加拉虎队——这是首次在寒冷天气城市举办的超级碗。

questions.prompt: The NFL’s forerunner was founded in 1920 in this Ohio city, at a car dealership.
questions.promptZh: NFL 的前身 1920 年在这座俄亥俄城市的汽车经销店成立。
questions.story: The American Professional Football Association — the NFL’s forerunner — was organized in Canton, Ohio, in September 1920 at Ralph Hay’s automobile dealership.
questions.storyZh: NFL 的前身“美国职业橄榄球协会”1920 年 9 月在俄亥俄州坎顿的拉尔夫·海汽车经销店成立。

questions.prompt: Kurt Warner stocked grocery shelves for $5.50 an hour in this Iowa city before winning Super Bowl XXXIV
questions.promptZh: 库尔特·华纳曾在这座爱荷华城市以每小时5.5美元的报酬在超市理货，后来赢得第34届超级碗
questions.story: Kurt Warner stocked shelves at a Hy-Vee in Cedar Falls, Iowa, for $5.50 an hour in 1994 before leading the St. Louis Rams to a Super Bowl XXXIV victory.
questions.storyZh: 1994年，库尔特·华纳在爱荷华州锡达福尔斯的Hy-Vee超市以每小时5.5美元理货，后来率领圣路易斯公羊队赢得第34届超级碗。

questions.prompt: Dan Marino, the last quarterback taken in the first round of the 1983 draft, was born in this city
questions.promptZh: 1983年选秀中最后一位首轮被选中的四分卫丹·马里诺出生在这座城市
questions.story: Dan Marino was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, on September 7, 1961. He played college football at the University of Pittsburgh and was the last of six quarterbacks taken in the first round of the famous 1983 NFL Draft.
questions.storyZh: 丹·马里诺1961年9月7日出生于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡，在匹兹堡大学打大学橄榄球，是著名的1983年 NFL 选秀中首轮被选中的六名四分卫里的最后一位。

questions.prompt: Since 2017, fans at this university’s stadium have waved to children watching from the hospital overlooking it.
questions.promptZh: 2017 年起，这所大学球场的球迷会向对面医院里观看比赛的孩子们挥手致意。
questions.story: Since 2017, Iowa Hawkeyes fans at Kinnick Stadium have waved toward the Stead Family Children’s Hospital between the first and second quarters.
questions.storyZh: 2017 年起，爱荷华鹰眼队球迷在 Kinnick 球场第一节与第二节之间，向斯特德家族儿童医院挥手致意。

questions.prompt: In 2022, the Packers played their first regular-season game abroad, in this city
questions.promptZh: 2022年，包装工队在这座城市打了一场队史首次海外常规赛
questions.story: On October 9, 2022, the Green Bay Packers played their first regular-season game outside the United States, losing to the New York Giants 27–22 at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 2022年10月9日，绿湾包装工队在伦敦托特纳姆热刺球场进行了队史首场美国境外常规赛，以22比27负于纽约巨人队。

sources.title: NFL Game Center: Giants at Packers, Oct 9, 2022

questions.prompt: In 2022, the NFL played its first regular-season game in Germany in this city
questions.promptZh: 2022年，NFL在这座城市举行了德国首场常规赛
questions.story: On November 13, 2022, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the Seattle Seahawks 21–16 at Munich's Allianz Arena in the NFL's first regular-season game in Germany.
questions.storyZh: 2022年11月13日，坦帕湾海盗队在慕尼黑安联球场以21比16击败西雅图海鹰队，这是NFL在德国的首场常规赛。

sources.title: NFL Game Center: Seahawks at Buccaneers, Nov 13, 2022

questions.prompt: A 1970 plane crash near this West Virginia city killed 37 Marshall football players
questions.promptZh: 1970年在这座西弗吉尼亚城市附近发生的空难，夺走了37名马歇尔大学橄榄球队员的生命
questions.story: Southern Airways Flight 932 crashed near Huntington, West Virginia, on November 14, 1970, killing all 75 aboard, including 37 Marshall University football players returning home.
questions.storyZh: 1970年11月14日，南方航空932号航班在西弗吉尼亚州亨廷顿附近坠毁，机上75人全部遇难，其中包括37名返家的马歇尔大学橄榄球队员。

questions.prompt: The NFL's only community-owned team has played here since 1957, at the league's oldest stadium in continuous use
questions.promptZh: NFL唯一由社区拥有的球队自1957年起在这座城市打球，使用联盟连续使用时间最长的球场
questions.story: Green Bay's Packers have been publicly owned since a 1923 stock sale and have played at Lambeau Field since 1957 — the oldest NFL stadium with a team in continuous residence.
questions.storyZh: 绿湾包装工队自1923年发售股票起由公众持有，自1957年起以兰博球场为主场——它是NFL中球队连续驻留时间最长的球场。

questions.prompt: Joe Namath guaranteed a win, then upset the Colts in Super Bowl III in 1969 at the Orange Bowl in this city
questions.promptZh: 1969年Super Bowl III在这座城市的Orange Bowl举行，Joe Namath赛前保证获胜，随后爆冷击败Colts
questions.story: At Miami’s Orange Bowl on January 12, 1969, Joe Namath’s guaranteed victory was followed by the New York Jets’ 16–7 upset of the Baltimore Colts in Super Bowl III.
questions.storyZh: 1969年1月12日，乔·纳马思保证纽约喷气机队获胜后，球队在迈阿密橙碗体育场以16比7击败巴尔的摩小马队，赢得第3届超级碗。

questions.prompt: Antonio Brown and J.J. Watt were teammates at this Midwestern university
questions.promptZh: 安东尼奥·布朗和J.J.瓦特曾在这所中西部大学做队友
questions.story: Antonio Brown and J.J. Watt played together at Central Michigan University in 2007 and 2008.
questions.storyZh: 安东尼奥·布朗和J.J.瓦特2007和2008赛季共同效力于中密歇根大学。

questions.prompt: The only perfect season in NFL history — 17–0 — was completed in 1972 by the team that plays in this city
questions.promptZh: NFL历史上唯一的完美赛季——17胜0负——由这座城市的球队在1972年完成
questions.story: The 1972 Miami Dolphins went 17–0 — the NFL's only perfect season — capping it with a 14–7 win over Washington in Super Bowl VII on January 14, 1973.
questions.storyZh: 1972年的迈阿密海豚队取得17胜0负——NFL唯一的完美赛季——并于1973年1月14日在第7届超级碗中以14比7击败华盛顿队收官。

questions.prompt: Tom Brady won 7 Super Bowls, but was a backup in this college town
questions.promptZh: Tom Brady赢得了7届超级碗，但在这座大学城只是一名替补
questions.story: Tom Brady was a backup quarterback at Penn State in State College before going on to win seven Super Bowls in the NFL.
questions.storyZh: 汤姆·布雷迪在宾夕法尼亚州州立大学的州学院校区担任替补四分卫，后来在NFL赢得了7次超级碗冠军。

questions.prompt: The first NFL Championship Game, played in this city in 1933, saw the Bears edge the Giants 23–21
questions.promptZh: 1933年在这座城市举行的首届NFL冠军赛中，熊队以23比21险胜巨人队
questions.story: On December 17, 1933, the Chicago Bears beat the New York Giants 23–21 in the first NFL Championship Game, played in Chicago.
questions.storyZh: 1933年12月17日，芝加哥熊队在芝加哥举行的首届NFL冠军赛中以23比21击败纽约巨人队。

questions.prompt: The first Fiesta Bowl was played in 1971 at this city's Sun Devil Stadium
questions.promptZh: 首届嘉年华碗（Fiesta Bowl）于1971年在这座城市的太阳恶魔体育场举行
questions.story: The inaugural Fiesta Bowl was played at Sun Devil Stadium in Tempe on December 27, 1971, where Arizona State beat Florida State 45–38.
questions.storyZh: 1971年12月27日，首届嘉年华碗在坦佩的太阳恶魔体育场举行，亚利桑那州立大学以45比38击败佛罗里达州立大学。

questions.prompt: After grenades ripped through his legs in Vietnam, Rocky Bleier was awarded a Purple Heart and won 4 Super Bowls for this city
questions.promptZh: 在越南被手榴弹炸伤双腿后，Rocky Bleier 获授紫心勋章，并为这座城市赢得了 4 次超级碗
questions.story: Pittsburgh Steelers running back Rocky Bleier received the Purple Heart after being wounded in Vietnam and later won four Super Bowls.
questions.storyZh: 匹兹堡钢人队跑卫洛基·布莱尔在越南受伤后获授紫心勋章，后来又随队四次赢得超级碗。

questions.prompt: The NFL Pro Bowl was held in this capital city from 1980 to 2009
questions.promptZh: 1980 年至 2009 年，NFL 职业碗一直在这座首都城市举办
questions.story: Honolulu hosted the NFL Pro Bowl for three decades, from 1980 through 2009.
questions.storyZh: 檀香山连续三十年承办NFL职业碗，时间从1980年一直到2009年。

questions.prompt: Joe Montana's four Super Bowl wins started with this Bay Area city
questions.promptZh: Joe Montana的四座超级碗冠军是从这座湾区城市起步的
questions.story: Joe Montana won the first of his four Super Bowls with the San Francisco 49ers in Super Bowl XVI, a 26–21 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals on January 24, 1982.
questions.storyZh: 1982年1月24日，Joe Montana在第16届超级碗中率领旧金山49人队以26比21击败辛辛那提孟加拉虎队，这是他四座超级碗中的第一座。

questions.prompt: Peyton Manning chose this SEC school over Ole Miss, his father Archie's alma mater
questions.promptZh: Peyton Manning 选择了这所东南联盟学校，并率队赢得1996年全国冠军
questions.story: Peyton Manning played quarterback for the Tennessee Volunteers and won the 1997 SEC Championship before going first overall in the 1998 NFL draft.
questions.storyZh: 佩顿·曼宁在田纳西志愿者队担任四分卫，1997 年夺得 SEC 冠军，随后在 1998 年 NFL 选秀中以状元身份被选中。

questions.prompt: Wentz and Lance both won national titles at this university
questions.promptZh: Wentz 和 Lance 都曾在这所大学赢得全国冠军
questions.story: Fayetteville is home to Fayetteville State University, an original member of the NCAA’s Alliance of American Football Conference when competition began in 2016; nearby Fort Bragg was renamed Fort Liberty in 2023 before restoring its historic name in 2025.
questions.storyZh: 费耶特维尔是费耶特维尔州立大学的所在地，该校也是NCAA美国联盟足球队在2016年成立时的创始成员之一；附近的布拉格堡于2023年更名为自由堡，并在2025年恢复历史名称。

sources.title: Wikipedia: North Dakota State Bison football

questions.prompt: Patrick Mahomes grew up in this city where his father pitched in the minors
questions.promptZh: Patrick Mahomes 在这座城市长大，他的父亲曾在这里效力于小联盟
questions.story: Alvin was where Patrick Mahomes Jr. grew up and learned football from his father, former minor-league pitcher Pat Mahomes Sr.; the younger Mahomes later won Super Bowl LIV in February 2020.
questions.storyZh: 阿尔文是帕特里克·马霍姆斯二世长大的地方，他的父亲、前小联盟投手帕特里克·马霍姆斯一世曾在那里指导他；小马霍姆斯随后在2020年2月赢得第54届超级碗。

questions.prompt: The true story behind 'Remember the Titans' unfolded at a high school in this Virginia city
questions.promptZh: 电影《记住巨人们》的真实故事发生在弗吉尼亚州这座城市的一所高中
questions.story: Remember the Titans is loosely based on the true story of coach Herman Boone, who integrated the T. C. Williams High School football team in Alexandria, Virginia, in 1971. The film was released in 2000.
questions.storyZh: 《记住巨人们》改编自教练赫尔曼·布恩的真实故事：1971年他在弗吉尼亚州亚历山德里亚的 T.C. Williams 高中带领球队完成种族融合。电影于2000年上映。

questions.prompt: The Raiders moved to this city in 2020, and its Allegiant Stadium hosted Super Bowl LVIII in 2024
questions.promptZh: 突袭者队2020年迁入这座城市，其忠诚航空体育场在2024年承办了第58届超级碗
questions.story: The Las Vegas Raiders began play at Allegiant Stadium in 2020; on February 11, 2024, the stadium hosted Super Bowl LVIII, where Kansas City beat San Francisco 25–22 in overtime.
questions.storyZh: 拉斯维加斯突袭者队2020年起以忠诚航空体育场为主场；2024年2月11日，该球场承办第58届超级碗，堪萨斯城酋长队经加时以25比22击败旧金山49人队。

questions.prompt: Joe Montana won a national title at this Catholic university's town before going pro in 1979
questions.promptZh: 1979 年进入职业联盟前，Joe Montana 曾在这所天主教大学所在的城镇赢得全国冠军
questions.story: South Bend’s Notre Dame capped an 11-1 season by defeating Texas 38-10 in the 1979 Fiesta Bowl, securing the national championship associated with Joe Montana’s college career before his 1979 NFL debut.
questions.storyZh: 南本德圣母大学在1979年-Fiesta Bowl中以38比10击败得克萨斯大学，以11胜1负结束赛季并夺得与乔·蒙塔纳大学时期相关的全国冠军，随后蒙塔纳在1979年进入NFL。

questions.prompt: Tom Brady, the 199th pick of the 2000 NFL Draft, grew up in this California city
questions.promptZh: Tom Brady 是 2000 年 NFL 选秀大会第 199 顺位选中的球员，他在这座加州城市长大
questions.story: San Mateo is where Tom Brady starred at Junipero Serra High School before the New England Patriots selected him with the 199th pick of the 2000 NFL Draft.
questions.storyZh: 汤姆·布雷迪在圣马特奥的胡内罗·塞拉高中效力，后来新英格兰爱国者在2000年NFL选秀中用第199顺位选下了他。

questions.prompt: This small Wisconsin city has hosted the Packers since 1957 at the 'Frozen Tundra'
questions.promptZh: 自 1957 年起，Packers 一直在这座威斯康星小城以“冰雪荒原”之名进行主场比赛
questions.story: The Packers have played their home games in Green Bay at Lambeau Field since 1957, earning the stadium its enduring nickname, the Frozen Tundra.
questions.storyZh: 包装工队自1957年起一直在格林贝的兰博球场进行主场比赛，这座球场也因此获得了“冻结苔原”的持久称号。

questions.prompt: Franco Harris's tipped-pass touchdown in this city won an AFC playoff game in 1972
questions.promptZh: 1972年，弗兰科·哈里斯在这座城市接到的“幸运一接”达阵赢下了一场美联季后赛
questions.story: On December 23, 1972, Franco Harris made the 'Immaculate Reception' at Three Rivers Stadium in Pittsburgh, giving the Steelers their first playoff victory, 13–7 over Oakland.
questions.storyZh: 1972年12月23日，弗兰科·哈里斯在匹兹堡三河体育场完成著名的“完美接球”（Immaculate Reception），帮助钢人队以13比7击败突袭者队，取得队史首场季后赛胜利。

questions.prompt: The largest stadium in the United States, The Big House, packs over 107,000 into this college town
questions.promptZh: 美国最大的体育场 The Big House 可容纳超过 10.7 万名观众，位于这座大学城
questions.story: Ann Arbor is home to the University of Michigan’s Michigan Stadium, known as The Big House, which seats 107,601 fans.
questions.storyZh: 安娜堡坐拥密歇根大学的密歇根体育场，它以“The Big House”之名闻名，可容纳107,601名观众。

questions.prompt: This Texas university's 'A&M' yell was led by the 12th Man
questions.promptZh: 这所 Texas 大学的“A&M”呐喊声曾由第 12 人领唱
questions.story: Texas A&M’s 12th Man tradition is said to date to October 27, 1917, when students were called on to lead the school’s famous yell during a football game.
questions.storyZh: 得克萨斯农工大学的“第12人”传统可追溯至1917年10月27日，据说当场比赛中，学生被召集起来带领全校呐喊助威。

questions.prompt: This university, home of the Spartans, was chartered in 1855 as the first agricultural college in the United States
questions.promptZh: 这所大学是斯巴达人队的主场，1855 年建校，是美国第一所农业学院
questions.story: Michigan State University in East Lansing was chartered in 1855 as the first agricultural college in the United States; its athletic teams are the Spartans.
questions.storyZh: 东兰辛的密歇根州立大学于1855年建校，是美国第一所农业学院，其校队名为“斯巴达人”。

questions.prompt: Nike was born on this campus when Bill Bowerman & Phil Knight built a waffle-inspired running shoe
questions.promptZh: Bill Bowerman 和 Phil Knight 在这座大学的校园里制造出灵感来自华夫饼的跑鞋，Nike 由此诞生
questions.story: Eugene is where Phil Knight and track coach Bill Bowerman founded Blue Ribbon Sports in 1964, the company that evolved into Nike and created the revolutionary waffle sole.
questions.storyZh: 尤金是菲尔·耐特与田径教练比尔·鲍尔曼于1964年创办蓝带体育公司的所在地，这家公司后来发展为耐克，并推出了具有革命性的华夫鞋底。

questions.prompt: Jesse Owens won 4 gold medals at the 1936 Summer Olympics in this city
questions.promptZh: Jesse Owens 在 1936 年夏季奥运会于此城夺得 4 枚金牌
questions.story: Berlin’s 1936 Summer Olympics became legendary when Jesse Owens won four gold medals, including victories in the long jump, 100 meters, 200 meters, and 4×100-meter relay.
questions.storyZh: 1936年柏林奥运会因杰西·欧文斯夺得4枚金牌而载入史册，他在跳远、100米、200米和4×100米接力项目中全部夺冠。

questions.prompt: Cal Ripken broke Lou Gehrig's ironman streak with his 2,131st straight game in 1995 in this city
questions.promptZh: 1995 年，卡尔·里普肯在这座城市以连续第 2,131 场比赛打破了卢·格里克的铁人纪录
questions.story: At Oriole Park at Camden Yards in Baltimore on September 6, 1995, Cal Ripken played his 2,131st consecutive game, surpassing Lou Gehrig's 56-year-old record of 2,130.
questions.storyZh: 1995 年 9 月 6 日，在巴尔的摩金莺公园，卡尔·里普肯完成连续第 2,131 场比赛，打破卢·格里克保持 56 年的 2,130 场纪录。

questions.prompt: After missing three seasons to serve as a Navy pilot in WWII, Ted Williams returned to this city to win AL MVP in 1946
questions.promptZh: 二战期间作为海军飞行员缺席三个赛季后，泰德·威廉姆斯回到这座城市并在 1946 年夺得美联 MVP
questions.story: Ted Williams, born in San Diego, missed the 1943–45 seasons serving as a Navy flyer. He returned to the Boston Red Sox in 1946 and hit .342; he won the AL MVP in 1949 (and had won the first of two Triple Crowns in 1942).
questions.storyZh: 泰德·威廉姆斯出生于圣迭戈，1943-45 年间作为海军飞行员缺席赛季。1946 年他回归波士顿红袜队，打击率 3 成 42；他于 1949 年获得美联 MVP，并于 1942 年首获三冠王。

questions.prompt: The 'Music City Miracle' saw Kevin Dyson return a lateraled kickoff for a TD with 3 seconds left in this city
questions.promptZh: “Music City Miracle”见证了 Kevin Dyson 在这座城市于开球回传后以 3 秒之差完成达阵
questions.story: The 'Music City Miracle' happened on January 8, 2000, in Nashville: Frank Wycheck threw a lateral to Kevin Dyson, who ran 75 yards for the winning touchdown with 15 seconds left, giving the Titans a 22-16 playoff win over Buffalo.
questions.storyZh: “音乐城奇迹”发生于2000年1月8日的纳什维尔：弗兰克·怀切克横向传球给凯文·戴森，后者推进75码完成制胜达阵，帮助泰坦队以22比16击败比卢队。

questions.prompt: The oldest ballpark still in use in the majors has stood in this city since 1912
questions.promptZh: 大联盟现存最古老的球场自 1912 年起就在这座城市
questions.story: Fenway Park opened in Boston in 1912 and is the oldest ballpark still in use in Major League Baseball, famous for its 37-foot-2-inch left-field wall, the 'Green Monster'.
questions.storyZh: 芬威球场 1912 年在波士顿启用，是大联盟现存最古老的球场，以 37 英尺 2 英寸高的左外野墙“绿色怪物”闻名。

questions.prompt: The original Yankee Stadium opened in 1923 in this New York borough
questions.promptZh: 最初的洋基体育场 1923 年在纽约的这个行政区启用
questions.story: The original Yankee Stadium opened in the Bronx in 1923, when the Yankees defeated the Boston Red Sox 4–3 in its first game. Known as 'The House That Ruth Built', it served the team until 2008.
questions.storyZh: 最初的洋基体育场 1923 年在布朗克斯启用，首场比赛中洋基队以 4 比 3 击败波士顿红袜队。它被称为“鲁斯建造的房子”，一直使用到 2008 年。

questions.prompt: In 1947, Jackie Robinson broke MLB's color barrier by making his Dodgers debut at a now-demolished park in this city
questions.promptZh: 1947 年，杰基·罗宾逊在这座城市一座现已拆除的球场代表道奇队首秀，打破大联盟肤色壁垒
questions.story: On April 15, 1947, Jackie Robinson took the field at Ebbets Field in Brooklyn for the Dodgers, becoming MLB's first Black player of the 20th century. Ebbets Field was demolished in 1960.
questions.storyZh: 1947 年 4 月 15 日，杰基·罗宾逊在布鲁克林埃比茨球场代表道奇队登场，成为 20 世纪大联盟首位黑人球员。埃比茨球场于 1960 年被拆除。

questions.prompt: Hall of Fame slugger David Ortiz, won 3 World Series with Boston. He was born in this capital city
questions.promptZh: 名人堂击球手 David Ortiz 随 Boston 赢得 3 次 World Series，出生在这座首都城市
questions.story: David Ortiz was born in Santo Domingo on November 15, 1974, and won three World Series titles with the Boston Red Sox.
questions.storyZh: 大卫·奥蒂斯于1974年11月15日出生在圣多明各，后来随波士顿红袜赢得了3次世界大赛冠军。

questions.prompt: The Yankees & White Sox played a game in a cornfield next to the 'Field of Dreams' movie site in this small town
questions.promptZh: Yankees 与 White Sox 曾在这座小镇的玉米田里、电影《梦幻球场》取景地旁进行过一场比赛
questions.story: The first Field of Dreams game was played on August 12, 2021, when the Chicago White Sox beat the New York Yankees 9–8 next to the movie site near Dyersville.
questions.storyZh: 2021 年 8 月 12 日，首场“梦幻球场”比赛在戴尔斯维尔的电影取景地旁举行，芝加哥白袜队 9-8 击败纽约洋基队。

sources.title: Wikipedia: MLB at Field of Dreams

questions.prompt: Ichiro has pro baseball's most career hits. 1,278 came with the Orix BlueWave in this Asian city
questions.promptZh: Ichiro 拥有职业棒球生涯最多的安打，其中 1,278 是在这座亚洲城市效力 Orix BlueWave 时击出的
questions.story: Ichiro began his professional career with the Orix BlueWave in Kobe in 1992, collecting 1,278 hits in Japan; his 4,367 combined hits are the most in top-level professional baseball.
questions.storyZh: 铃木一朗1992年在神户的欧力士蓝浪队开启职业生涯，在日本累积1,278支安打；他顶级职业棒球生涯合计4,367支安打，为史上最多。

questions.prompt: A 1969 MLB expansion team went bankrupt after 1 season. They later became the Brewers, but they first played here
questions.promptZh: 一支 1969 年加入 MLB 的扩张球队首个赛季便破产，后来成为 Brewers，最初曾在这座城市效力
questions.story: The Seattle Pilots began playing in 1969 and moved to Milwaukee after their inaugural season, eventually becoming the Milwaukee Brewers.
questions.storyZh: 西雅图飞行员队在1969年展开首个赛季，结束后迁往密尔沃基，后来成为密尔沃基酿酒人。

questions.prompt: Game 5 of the 2017 World Series in this city produced 25 runs, the most in a World Series game this century.
questions.promptZh: 2017 年世界大赛第 5 场在这座城市打出 25 分，是本世纪世界大赛单场得分之最。
questions.story: The Astros’ 13–12, ten-inning win over the Dodgers in 2017 World Series Game 5 produced 25 runs and ended on Alex Bregman’s walk-off single.
questions.storyZh: 2017 年世界大赛第 5 场，太空人队 13-12 十局再见打击败道奇队，全场共得 25 分，亚历克斯·布雷格曼打出再见安打。

questions.prompt: This city’s MLB ballpark opened in 2012 with saltwater aquariums full of tropical fish behind home plate.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的 MLB 球场 2012 年启用，本垒板后方设有养着热带鱼的海水水族箱。
questions.story: The Miami Marlins’ ballpark opened in 2012 as Marlins Park (now loanDepot park), with saltwater aquariums full of tropical fish built in behind home plate.
questions.storyZh: 迈阿密马林鱼队的球场 2012 年以“马林鱼公园”之名启用（现名 loanDepot park），本垒板后方建有养着热带鱼的海水水族箱。

questions.prompt: Hall of Famer Roberto Clemente, the first Latino player so honored, was born in this city just outside Puerto Rico's capital
questions.promptZh: 棒球名人堂成员Roberto Clemente是首位获此殊荣的拉美裔球员，他出生在这座波多黎各首府附近的城市
questions.story: Roberto Clemente was born in Carolina, Puerto Rico, in 1934 and became the first Latino and Caribbean player inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 1973.
questions.storyZh: 罗伯托·克莱门特1934年出生在波多黎各的卡罗莱纳，1973年成为首位入选美国国家棒球名人堂的拉美及加勒比地区球员。

questions.prompt: Xander Bogaerts, a 10 time Gold Glove center fielder, was born in the capital of this small Dutch Caribbean island
questions.promptZh: 10 次金手套奖得主 Xander Bogaerts,出生在这座荷兰加勒比小岛的首府
questions.story: Oranjestad, the capital of Curaçao, was the birthplace of Xander Bogaerts, the MLB center fielder who won 10 Gold Glove Awards.
questions.storyZh: 库拉索首都奥拉涅斯塔德是 MLB 中外野手 Xander Bogaerts 的出生地，他曾获得 10 次金手套奖。

questions.prompt: In 1996, the Padres and Mets played the first MLB regular-season game outside the US and Canada in this city
questions.promptZh: 1996年，教士队和大都会队在这座城市进行了美国和加拿大境外的首场MLB常规赛
questions.story: The Padres and Mets opened a three-game series in Monterrey in August 1996 — the first MLB regular-season games played outside the United States and Canada.
questions.storyZh: 1996年8月，教士队与大都会队在蒙特雷进行了三场系列赛，这是MLB常规赛首次在美国和加拿大境外举行。

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Major League Baseball games played outside the United States and Canada

questions.prompt: Aaron Judge, who broke the American League single-season home run record, grew up in this small California town
questions.promptZh: 打破美国联盟单赛季本垒打纪录的Aaron Judge在这个加州小镇长大
questions.story: Aaron Judge was born in Sacramento in 1992 and grew up in nearby Linden, California, before setting the American League single-season home run record with 62 home runs in 2022.
questions.storyZh: Aaron Judge 1992年出生在萨克拉门托，在附近的加州小镇林登长大，2022年以62支本垒打刷新美国联盟单赛季纪录。

questions.prompt: Miguel Cabrera, 2012 Triple Crown winner, grew up on this city's sandlots
questions.promptZh: Miguel Cabrera——2012 年三冠王——在这座城市的沙地棒球场长大
questions.story: Miguel Cabrera was born in Maracay on April 18, 1983, and won the 2012 Triple Crown by leading MLB in batting average, home runs and RBIs.
questions.storyZh: 米格尔·卡布雷拉于1983年4月18日出生在马拉凯，并在2012年赢得三冠王，同时领跑大联盟的打击率、本垒打和打点。

questions.prompt: The last major league park to install lights, in 1988, hosted only day games for decades in this city
questions.promptZh: 这座球场是 1988 年最后安装灯光的 MLB 球场，多年来只承办日间比赛，位于这座城市
questions.story: Candlestick Park in San Francisco became MLB's last major-league ballpark to install lights in 1988, long after it had earned a reputation as a hitter's park.
questions.storyZh: 旧金山的烛台公园在1988年成为大联盟最后安装照明系统的主要球场，而它早已因适合击球手发挥而闻名。

questions.prompt: Hobbled Kirk Gibson hit a pinch-hit walk-off homer in the 1988 World Series opener in this city
questions.promptZh: 在 1988 年 World Series 揭幕战中，受伤跛足的 Kirk Gibson 于这座城市击出代打再见本垒打
questions.story: On October 13, 1988, a hobbled Kirk Gibson delivered a pinch-hit walk-off homer in the World Series opener at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.
questions.storyZh: 1988年10月13日，带伤行动的柯克·吉布森在洛杉矶道奇体育场举行的世界大赛揭幕战中，替补上场击出再见本垒打。

questions.prompt: Cuban flamethrower Aroldis Chapman, owner of the fastest pitch in MLB history, hails from this city
questions.promptZh: 拥有MLB历史最快球速的古巴火焰投手Aroldis Chapman来自这座城市
questions.story: Aroldis Chapman, born in Holguín in 1988, holds the record for the fastest recorded pitch in MLB history at 105.8 mph.
questions.storyZh: 阿罗尔迪斯·查普曼 1988 年出生于奥尔金，以 105.8 英里/小时保持着 MLB 最快投球纪录。

questions.prompt: This city is home to Spalding, the sporting goods maker whose baseball equipment shaped the game
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是体育用品制造商斯伯丁的所在地，其棒球装备塑造了这项运动
questions.story: Chicago-based A.G. Spalding & Bros. was founded in 1876 and became one of the most influential makers of baseballs and other sporting equipment in the game's history.
questions.storyZh: 总部位于芝加哥的 A.G. Spalding & Bros. 创立于 1876 年，成为棒球史上最具影响力的棒球及体育器材制造商之一。

questions.prompt: The Mets won the World Series in 1969 and 1986 while based in this New York City borough
questions.promptZh: 大都会队在这座纽约市辖区夺得1969和1986年世界大赛冠军
questions.story: The New York Mets won the World Series in 1969 and 1986 while playing at Shea Stadium in Flushing, Queens.
questions.storyZh: 纽约大都会队在皇后区法拉盛的谢亚球场夺得1969和1986年世界大赛冠军。

questions.prompt: Seattle Mariners ace Félix Hernández, who threw a perfect game in 2012, grew up in this Venezuelan city.
questions.promptZh: 西雅图水手队王牌费利克斯·埃尔南德斯在这座委内瑞拉城市长大，2012 年投出完全比赛。
questions.story: Félix Hernández was born and raised in Valencia, Venezuela, and threw a perfect game for the Seattle Mariners on August 15, 2012.
questions.storyZh: 费利克斯·埃尔南德斯在委内瑞拉瓦伦西亚出生长大，2012 年 8 月 15 日为西雅图水手队投出完全比赛。

questions.prompt: The College World Series has been held annually in this city since 1950
questions.promptZh: 大学世界大赛自1950年起每年都在这座城市举行
questions.story: Omaha has hosted the College World Series every year since 1950, making it one of baseball’s most enduring championship settings.
questions.storyZh: 自1950年起，班夫德大学世界大赛便每年在奥马哈举行，使其成为棒球史上延续最久的冠军举办地之一。

questions.prompt: Before becoming the first overall NFL Draft pick in 2019, Kyler Murray went 9th in the 2018 MLB Draft to the team that played here
questions.promptZh: 在2019年成为 NFL 选秀状元之前，凯勒·穆雷在2018年 MLB 选秀第9顺位被这里曾效力的球队选中
questions.story: The Oakland Athletics selected Kyler Murray ninth overall in the 2018 MLB Draft. A year later he was taken first overall by the Arizona Cardinals in the 2019 NFL Draft, becoming the first player drafted in the first round of both sports.
questions.storyZh: 奥克兰运动家队在2018年 MLB 选秀第9顺位选中凯勒·穆雷；一年后他在2019年 NFL 选秀中以状元身份被亚利桑那红雀队选中，成为首位在两项运动中都进入首轮被选中的球员。

questions.prompt: On “Ten-Cent Beer Night” in 1974, a beer-fueled riot forced this city’s MLB team to forfeit a game.

questions.prompt: Before moving to Canada at 18 months old, two-time NBA MVP Steve Nash was born in this city
questions.promptZh: 两届NBA MVP Steve Nash出生在这座城市，18个月大时随家人移居加拿大
questions.story: Steve Nash was born in Johannesburg on February 7, 1974, and moved to Canada with his family when he was 18 months old.
questions.storyZh: Steve Nash 1974年2月7日出生在约翰内斯堡，18个月大时随家人移居加拿大。

questions.prompt: The NBA's first official three-point shot was made in this city on opening night 1979, by Celtics guard Chris Ford
questions.promptZh: 1979年NBA新赛季揭幕之夜，凯尔特人队后卫Chris Ford在这座城市投中了NBA第一记正式三分球
questions.story: Celtics guard Chris Ford made the first official three-point shot in NBA history on October 12, 1979, when the NBA opened its first season with the three-point line.
questions.storyZh: 1979年10月12日，NBA启用三分线的首个赛季揭幕，凯尔特人队后卫Chris Ford投中了NBA历史上第一记正式三分球。

questions.prompt: A mischievous coyote mascot has entertained crowds for the 5 time champions in this city since 1983
questions.promptZh: 自1983年以来，调皮的郊狼吉祥物一直为这座城市的五届总冠军球队娱乐现场观众
questions.story: The Coyote has been an unofficial entertainer at San Antonio Spurs games since 1983, appearing during the franchise’s run to five NBA championships.
questions.storyZh: 自1983年起，狐狸“The Coyote”一直是圣安东尼奥马刺队场边的非官方表演者，见证了球队五夺NBA总冠军的历程。

questions.prompt: Charles Barkley was born in this Alabama city
questions.promptZh: Charles Barkley 出生在这座阿拉巴马州城市
questions.story: Charles Barkley was born in Leeds, Alabama, on February 20, 1963, before becoming one of the NBA’s most dominant power forwards.
questions.storyZh: 查尔斯·巴克利于1963年2月20日出生在阿拉巴马州利兹，后来成为NBA最具统治力的内线球员之一。

questions.prompt: Bill Walton led this city to their only NBA title in 1977
questions.promptZh: 1977年，Bill Walton 带领这座城市的球队赢得队史唯一的 NBA 总冠军
questions.story: Bill Walton led the Portland Trail Blazers to their only NBA championship in 1977 and was named Finals MVP after the Blazers defeated the Philadelphia 76ers.
questions.storyZh: 1977年，比尔·沃尔顿带领波特兰开拓者队赢得队史唯一一次NBA总冠军，并在击败费城76人后当选总决赛最有价值球员。

questions.prompt: Clyde 'The Glide' Drexler's No. 22 hangs in this city's arena
questions.promptZh: Clyde “The Glide” Drexler 的22号球衣悬挂在这座城市的球馆里
questions.story: Clyde “The Glide” Drexler’s No. 22 was retired by the Portland Trail Blazers in 2004 and hangs in the arena as a tribute to the franchise’s celebrated forward.
questions.storyZh: 克莱德“The Glide”德雷克勒的22号球衣于2004年被波特兰开拓者队退役，并悬挂球馆上空，以纪念这位球队传奇前锋。

questions.prompt: The Royals captured this city's only NBA title in 1951, long before the franchise became the Sacramento Kings
questions.promptZh: 1951年，Royals 队为这座城市赢得了唯一的 NBA 总冠军，当时球队尚未更名为 Sacramento Kings
questions.story: The Rochester Royals beat the New York Knicks in seven games to win the 1951 NBA championship — the franchise's only title.
questions.storyZh: 罗切斯特皇家队在1951年NBA总决赛中七战击败纽约尼克斯，夺得该队队史唯一总冠军。

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant moved to this Italian city at age six, when his father joined the local pro basketball team
questions.promptZh: 科比六岁时随父亲搬到这座意大利城市，当时他的父亲加盟了当地的职业篮球队
questions.story: When Kobe Bryant was six, his father Joe Bryant moved the family to Rieti, Italy, to play for AMG Sebastiani Rieti; Kobe later lived in Reggio Calabria, Pistoia and Reggio Emilia.
questions.storyZh: 科比六岁时，父亲Joe Bryant加盟当地球队AMG Sebastiani Rieti，全家搬到意大利列蒂；此后科比先后在雷焦卡拉布里亚、皮斯托亚和雷焦艾米利亚生活。

questions.prompt: Jim Brown was an All-American in football AND lacrosse at this city
questions.promptZh: Jim Brown 在这座城市的橄榄球和长曲棍球项目中都曾入选全美最佳阵容
questions.story: Jim Brown earned unanimous All-America honors in football at Syracuse and is widely regarded as one of the greatest lacrosse players of all time.
questions.storyZh: 吉姆·布朗在雪城大学橄榄球队获得全票全美最佳阵容荣誉，并被公认为长曲棍球史上最伟大的球员之一。

questions.prompt: The Toronto Raptors' first star, Damon Stoudamire, played college basketball at the university in this Arizona city
questions.promptZh: 猛龙队初代球星Damon Stoudamire来自这座亚利桑那城市的大学
questions.story: Damon Stoudamire was drafted seventh overall by the Toronto Raptors in 1995 out of the University of Arizona in Tucson and won Rookie of the Year that season.
questions.storyZh: Damon Stoudamire 1995年选秀第7顺位被猛龙队选中，来自图森的亚利桑那大学，当赛季荣获最佳新秀。

questions.prompt: During the 2011 NBA lockout, three-time All-Star Deron Williams played for Besiktas in this city
questions.promptZh: 2011年NBA停摆期间，三届全明星Deron Williams在这座城市为贝西克塔斯队效力
questions.story: During the 2011 NBA lockout, Deron Williams — a three-time NBA All-Star — left the Utah Jazz to play for Besiktas in Istanbul.
questions.storyZh: 2011年NBA停摆期间，三届全明星球员Deron Williams离开犹他爵士，赴伊斯坦布尔为贝西克塔斯队打球。

questions.prompt: In 2015, Frank Kaminsky's Wisconsin ended Kentucky's 38-0 season with a 71-64 Final Four win at this converted NFL stadium
questions.promptZh: 2015年，Wisconsin 在这座城市一座由 NFL 球场改建而成的体育场以71比64击败 Kentucky，终结其38连胜并闯入最终四强
questions.story: On April 4, 2015, Frank Kaminsky's Wisconsin beat Kentucky 71-64 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, snapping the Wildcats' 38-game winning streak on the same field where the Indianapolis Colts play.
questions.storyZh: 2015年4月4日弗兰克·卡明斯基领衔的威斯康星队在印第安纳波利斯的卢卡斯油橄榄球场以71比64击败肯塔基，终结对手38连胜，而这座球场正是印第安纳波利斯小马队的主场。

questions.prompt: As a 9-seed, the 'Shockers' made a cinderella run to the 2013 Final Four representing this city

questions.story: A 9-seed, Wichita State became the first No. 9 seed to reach the Final Four since 1985; the Shockers lost there to eventual champion Louisville.
questions.storyZh: 9 号种子威奇托州立成为 1985 年以来首支打进四强的 9 号种子，但在四强赛负于最终冠军路易斯维尔。

questions.prompt: This Big Ten stadium is named for a Union Army training camp used during the Civil War.
questions.promptZh: 这座 Big Ten 球场以南北战争时期一座联邦军训练营命名。
questions.story: Camp Randall Stadium in Madison takes its name from the Civil War Union Army training camp that stood nearby; the Wisconsin Badgers have played there since 1917.
questions.storyZh: 麦迪逊的坎德尔体育场之名来自附近的南北战争联邦军训练营；威斯康星獾队自 1917 年起在此比赛。

questions.prompt: Mike Krzyzewski played point guard for Bobby Knight at this service academy from 1966 to 1969
questions.promptZh: 迈克·克日泽夫斯基1966至1969年在阿姆斯特朗服役期间为陆军球队打控卫，师从鲍比·奈特
questions.story: Mike Krzyzewski played point guard at Army from 1966 to 1969 under coach Bob Knight, captainting the Cadets in his senior season.
questions.storyZh: 迈克·克日泽夫斯基1966至1969年在陆军学院（西点）担任控卫，师从鲍比·奈特，并在大四赛季担任队长。

questions.prompt: LeBron James announced 'The Decision' to join Miami on live TV in 2010 from a club in this town
questions.promptZh: 2010年，LeBron James在一家俱乐部现场直播中宣布“The Decision”，宣布将加盟新东家
questions.story: On December 23, 2010, LeBron James told ESPN viewers in Cleveland that he was taking his talents to South Beach, and The Decision instantly reshaped the NBA.
questions.storyZh: 2010年12月23日，勒布朗·詹姆斯在克利夫兰通过ESPN向全世界宣布自己将加盟迈阿密热火，这段被称为The Decision的宣言瞬间重塑了NBA格局。

questions.prompt: Kyle MVP, Jerry West aka 'The Logo,' was a 5x All-American at this college whose state shares his name
questions.promptZh: Kyle MVP和绰号“The Logo”的Jerry West曾是这所大学的5届全美最佳阵容球员，而这所大学所在的州与他的名字相同
questions.story: Jerry West was a five-time All-American at West Virginia from 1953 to 1959, and his dribbling silhouette became the NBA's official logo from 1969 until 1978.
questions.storyZh: 杰里·韦斯特在1953年至1959年间为西弗吉尼亚大学效力并五次入选全美最佳阵容，他运球的剪影从1969年到1978年一直被用作NBA官方标志。

questions.prompt: In the 1993 NBA Finals, this city's Suns took Michael Jordan's Bulls to six games.
questions.promptZh: 1993 年 NBA 总决赛，这座城市的太阳队与迈克尔·乔丹的公牛队大战六场。
questions.story: Charles Barkley's 62-win Phoenix Suns lost the 1993 NBA Finals to the Chicago Bulls in six games; John Paxson's three-pointer in Game 6 sealed the Bulls' first 'three-peat'.
questions.storyZh: 查尔斯·巴克利率领的 62 胜太阳队在 1993 年 NBA 总决赛六场不敌芝加哥公牛队；第 6 场约翰·帕克森的三分球帮助公牛队完成首个“三连冠”。

questions.prompt: In 2008 this city's Tigers, led by freshman Derrick Rose under coach John Calipari, reached the NCAA championship game
questions.promptZh: 2008年，这座城市的老虎队在主帅约翰·卡利帕里和大一新生德里克·罗斯带领下闯入NCAA冠军赛
questions.story: Memphis's 2007–08 Tigers reached the 2008 NCAA title game behind freshman Derrick Rose and coach John Calipari; the season's wins were later vacated over Rose's eligibility.
questions.storyZh: 2007-08赛季的孟菲斯老虎队在大一新生德里克·罗斯和主帅卡利帕里带领下闯入2008年NCAA冠军赛，后因罗斯参赛资格问题被取消该赛季战绩。

questions.prompt: This Caribbean capital is the base of the Jamaican bobsled team that debuted at the 1988 Winter Olympics
