questions.story: Jamaica's bobsled team, based in Kingston, made its celebrated debut at the 1988 Calgary Winter Olympics; pilot Dudley Stokes and pusher Michael White raced in the two-man event.
questions.storyZh: 牙买加雪车队以金斯敦为基地，1988年卡尔加里冬奥会首秀，Dudley Stokes和Michael White搭档参加双人雪车比赛。

questions.prompt: Muhammad Ali's famous 'Rumble in the Jungle' victory over George Foreman took place in this African capital
questions.promptZh: Muhammad Ali在“丛林之战”中击败George Foreman的著名胜利发生在这座非洲首都
questions.story: On October 30, 1974, Muhammad Ali defeated George Foreman in Kinshasa’s famous Rumble in the Jungle, knocking Foreman down in the eighth round.
questions.storyZh: 1974年10月30日，穆罕默德·阿里在金沙哈的“丛林之战”中击败乔治·福尔曼，并在第八回合将对手击倒。

questions.prompt: Ivan Drago, the antagonist of Rocky IV, trained in this European capital
questions.promptZh: 《Rocky IV》中的反派Ivan Drago曾在这座欧洲首都接受训练
questions.story: Saint Petersburg, known as Leningrad from 1924 to 1991, supplies the bleak Soviet atmosphere that heightens Ivan Drago’s formidable presence in Rocky IV.
questions.storyZh: 圣彼得堡在1924年至1991年间以列宁格勒之名存在，其阴冷的苏联氛围强化了《洛奇四世》中伊万·德拉戈令人畏惧的形象。

questions.prompt: Canelo Álvarez, boxing’s four-belt undisputed super middleweight champion, was born in 1990 in this Mexican city.
questions.promptZh: 拳坛四带统一超中量级冠军卡内洛·阿尔瓦雷斯 1990 年出生在这座墨西哥城市。
questions.story: Canelo Álvarez was born in Guadalajara on July 18, 1990, and in 2021 became boxing’s first undisputed four-belt super middleweight champion.
questions.storyZh: 卡内洛·阿尔瓦雷斯 1990 年 7 月 18 日出生于瓜达拉哈拉，2021 年成为拳击史上首位四大组织统一超中量级冠军。

questions.prompt: Oleksandr Usyk defeated Tyson Fury in 2024 in this city to become the first undisputed heavyweight champion in the four-belt era
questions.promptZh: 2024 年，奥列克桑德尔·乌西克击败泰森·富里，成为四大组织时代首位无可争议重量级拳王
questions.story: On May 18, 2024, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Oleksandr Usyk defeated Tyson Fury by split decision to become the first undisputed heavyweight champion since Lennox Lewis in 1999.
questions.storyZh: 2024 年 5 月 18 日，在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的王国球场，奥列克桑德尔·乌西克以分歧判定击败泰森·富里，成为自 1999 年刘易斯·刘易斯以来首位无可争议重量级拳王。

questions.prompt: Before being stripped of all his titles, Lance Armstrong won cycling's biggest race 7 times, all finishing in this city
questions.promptZh: 在被剥夺全部冠军头衔之前，Lance Armstrong曾7次赢得自行车赛这项最大赛事，而终点都在这座城市
questions.story: Lance Armstrong won the Tour de France seven times, with every edition finishing in Paris, before his titles were stripped in 2012.
questions.storyZh: 兰斯·阿姆斯特朗曾七次赢得环法自行车赛，所有赛段都在巴黎收官，但他的冠军头衔于2012年被剥夺。

questions.prompt: Tiger Woods was born in 1975 in this city
questions.promptZh: Tiger Woods 于1975年出生在这座城市
questions.story: Tiger Woods was born in Cypress, California, on December 30, 1975, and grew up to become one of golf’s most celebrated champions.
questions.storyZh: 老虎·伍兹于1975年12月30日出生在加利福尼亚州赛普里斯，后来成长为高尔夫史上最著名的冠军之一。

questions.prompt: Bobby Jones and Alister MacKenzie transformed a former plant nursery into a legendary course in this Georgia city
questions.promptZh: 鲍比·琼斯与阿利斯特·麦肯齐在这座佐治亚城市将一座前苗圃改建为传奇球场
questions.story: Bobby Jones and Alister MacKenzie converted the former Fruitland Nurseries property into Augusta National Golf Club, which hosted the first Masters Tournament in 1934.
questions.storyZh: 鲍比·琼斯与阿利斯特·麦肯齐将前弗鲁特兰苗圃地改建为奥古斯塔国家高尔夫俱乐部，并于 1934 年举办了首届大师赛。

questions.prompt: Phil Mickelson became the oldest major champion in golf history by winning the 2021 PGA Championship at this course
questions.promptZh: 菲尔·米克尔森通过赢得 2021 年 PGA 锦标赛，成为高尔夫史上最年长的大满贯冠军
questions.story: At age 50, Phil Mickelson won the 2021 PGA Championship at the Ocean Course on Kiawah Island, South Carolina, becoming the oldest major champion in men's golf history.
questions.storyZh: 菲尔·米克尔森50岁时在南卡罗来纳州基阿瓦岛海洋球场赢得2021年PGA锦标赛，成为男子高尔夫史上最年长的大满贯冠军。

questions.prompt: This city has been home to the Masters Tournament every year since 1934 (except 1943–45)
questions.promptZh: 这座城市自 1934 年起每年举办大师赛（1943-45 年除外）
questions.story: The Masters Tournament has been played annually at Augusta National in Augusta, Georgia, since 1934 (except 1943–45 during World War II).
questions.storyZh: 大师赛自 1934 年起（二战期间 1943-45 年停办除外）每年在佐治亚州奥古斯塔的奥古斯塔国家高尔夫俱乐部举行。

questions.prompt: This North Carolina golf village's No. 2 course, designed by Donald Ross, has hosted five men's majors.
questions.promptZh: 这座北卡罗来纳高尔夫小镇的 2 号球场由唐纳德·罗斯设计，已举办五场男子大满贯赛事。
questions.story: Pinehurst No. 2 opened in 1907 to Donald Ross's design and has hosted the 1936 PGA Championship plus the U.S. Opens of 1999, 2005, 2014 and 2024; the USGA has named Pinehurst its first 'anchor site'.
questions.storyZh: 松树丛 2 号球场 1907 年按唐纳德·罗斯的设计建成，承办过 1936 年 PGA 锦标赛以及 1999、2005、2014、2024 年美国公开赛；USGA 已将松树丛列为首个“锚定赛事场地”。

questions.prompt: 2013 Masters champion Adam Scott — the first Australian to win the event — was born in this southern-hemisphere city
questions.promptZh: 2013年大师赛冠军、首位赢得该赛事的澳大利亚人Adam Scott出生在这座南半球城市
questions.story: Adam Scott was born in Adelaide, South Australia, in 1980 and in 2013 became the first Australian to win the Masters.
questions.storyZh: Adam Scott 1980年出生在南澳大利亚州阿德莱德，2013年成为首位赢得美国大师赛的澳大利亚人。

questions.prompt: The Open Championship regularly returns to The Old Course in this city where golf has been played since 1552
questions.promptZh: 英国公开赛经常重返这座城市的 The Old Course，自1552年以来这里便一直有人打高尔夫
questions.story: Golf has been played at the Old Course in St Andrews since at least 1552, and it is closely associated with The Open Championship.
questions.storyZh: 至少从1552年起，人们便在圣安德鲁斯的老球场打球，这座球场也与英国公开赛紧密相连。

questions.prompt: This Arizona city is the birthplace of Kerri Strug, whose vault clinched the 1996 Olympic team gold
questions.promptZh: 这座亚利桑那城市是克里·斯特鲁格的出生地，她的跳马帮助美国队夺得1996年奥运团体金牌
questions.story: Kerri Strug was born in Tucson, Arizona, on November 19, 1977; her vault clinched the U.S. women's team gold at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics.
questions.storyZh: 克里·斯特鲁格1977年11月19日出生于亚利桑那州图森；她在1996年亚特兰大奥运会的跳马帮助美国女队夺得团体金牌。

questions.prompt: Fresh off the 2024 Cup, the Panthers met the Stars in 2 NHL Global Series games at the Nokia Arena in this city
questions.promptZh: 刚赢得2024年Cup后，Panthers 在这座城市的 Nokia Arena 与 Stars 进行了2场NHL Global Series比赛
questions.story: Tempe is home to Arizona State University’s Sun Devils, whose program was founded in 1885 and became a major force in college sports.
questions.storyZh: 坦佩是亚利桑那州立大学太阳 Devil 队的所在地，这支球队创立于1885年，后来成为大学体育的重要力量。

questions.prompt: Before joining the Hurricanes in 1997, the NHL's Whalers spent 18 seasons here
questions.promptZh: 在这里效力18个赛季后，NHL的 Whalers 于1997年加盟 Hurricanes
questions.story: The Hartford Whalers played in Connecticut from 1979 through 1997 before moving to North Carolina and becoming the Carolina Hurricanes in 1997.
questions.storyZh: 哈特福德鲸鱼队从1979年到1997年在康涅狄格州效力，随后迁往北卡罗来纳州，并于1997年改名为卡罗来纳飓风队。

questions.prompt: A disputed 'No Goal' in triple OT of the '99 Stanley Cup Final still stings the blue and gold fans of this city
questions.promptZh: 1999年斯坦利杯决赛三加时赛中的争议“零进球”，至今仍让这座城市的蓝金球衣球迷心中刺痛
questions.story: The Dallas Stars took Game 6 of the 1999 Stanley Cup Final in triple overtime on Brett Hull's controversial goal — replays showed his skate in the crease — and Sabres fans still call it 'No Goal'.
questions.storyZh: 1999 年斯坦利杯决赛第 6 场，达拉斯星队在第三个加时凭借布雷特·赫尔的争议进球取胜——慢镜显示他的冰刀在球门区内——水牛城球迷至今称之为“不存在的进球”。

questions.prompt: The Flames won the 1989 Stanley Cup for this city, which had just hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics
questions.promptZh: Flames 为这座城市赢得了1989年斯坦利杯，而这里刚刚主办过1988年冬奥会
questions.story: Calgary hosted the 1988 Winter Olympics, and the Calgary Flames responded the following year by winning the 1989 Stanley Cup.
questions.storyZh: 卡尔加里主办了1988年冬季奥运会，次年的1989年，卡尔加里火焰队便夺得了斯坦利杯。

questions.prompt: At just 19 years old, Yogi Berra fired rockets from a Navy boat onto this European beach during D-Day
questions.promptZh: 年仅19岁的 Yogi Berra 在诺曼底登陆日从一艘海军舰船上向这座欧洲海滩发射火箭弹
questions.story: On D-Day, June 6, 1944, 19-year-old Yogi Berra served in the U.S. Navy and fired rockets from a landing craft toward German positions off Normandy.
questions.storyZh: 1944年6月6日登陆日当天，19岁的耶奇·贝拉服役于美国海军，从登陆艇上向诺曼底外海的德军阵地发射火箭。

questions.prompt: Bobby Orr revolutionized hockey & won 8 straight Norris Trophies as a D-man. He's from this small town
questions.promptZh: Bobby Orr 革新了冰球运动，并连续8次当选 Norris Trophy 最佳防守球员，他来自这座小镇
questions.story: Bobby Orr was born in Parry Sound on March 20, 1948, and won eight consecutive Norris Trophies from 1968 through 1975.
questions.storyZh: 博比·奥尔 1948 年 3 月 20 日出生于帕里桑德，1968 至 1975 年连续八次获得诺里斯奖。

questions.prompt: The NHL franchise in this city, revived in 1992 after decades of absence, reached its first Stanley Cup Final in 2007
questions.promptZh: 这座城市1992年复活的NHL球队，在2007年首次打进斯坦利杯决赛
questions.story: The modern Ottawa Senators joined the NHL in 1992, reviving one of hockey's historic names; they reached their first Stanley Cup Final in 2007, losing to the Anaheim Ducks in five games.
questions.storyZh: 现代渥太华参议员队1992年加入NHL，重启了冰球史上的传奇队名；2007年球队首次打进斯坦利杯决赛，五场负于安纳海姆巨鸭队。

questions.prompt: Three-time Hart Trophy winner Connor McDavid was born in this Ontario city
questions.promptZh: 三届哈特奖得主Connor McDavid出生在这座安大略城市
questions.story: Connor McDavid was born in Richmond Hill, Ontario, in 1997 and won the Hart Trophy as the NHL's most valuable player three times.
questions.storyZh: Connor McDavid 1997年出生在安大略省列治文山，三次荣获NHL最有价值球员哈特奖。

questions.prompt: The NHL's all-time leading scorer, Wayne Gretzky, grew up in this Ontario city
questions.promptZh: NHL历史得分王Wayne Gretzky在这座安大略城市长大
questions.story: Wayne Gretzky was born in Brantford, Ontario, in 1961 and finished his NHL career with a record 2,857 regular-season points.
questions.storyZh: Wayne Gretzky 1961年出生在安大略省布兰特福德，职业生涯以2857个常规赛积分结束，至今仍是NHL历史纪录。

questions.prompt: This Texas city earned the nickname 'Clutch City' after its NBA team won back-to-back championships in 1994 and 1995
questions.promptZh: 这座德克萨斯城市因当地NBA球队在1994和1995年连续夺冠而获得“关键之城”的绰号
questions.story: Houston earned the nickname 'Clutch City' after the Rockets won consecutive NBA titles in 1994 and 1995.
questions.storyZh: 休斯顿火箭队1994和1995年连续夺得NBA总冠军，城市因此获得“Clutch City（关键之城）”的绰号。

questions.prompt: After this city lost Game 7 of the 2011 Stanley Cup Final, fans burned cars and looted in the downtown area
questions.promptZh: 这座城市在2011年 Stanley Cup 总决赛第七场落败后，市中心发生烧车和哄抢事件
questions.story: Vancouver’s composure broke after the Canucks lost Game 7 of the 2011 Stanley Cup Final, prompting fans to set cars ablaze and loot downtown streets.
questions.storyZh: 2011年斯坦利杯总决赛抢七战中，温哥华Canucks队败北，看台上的愤怒随后蔓延到市中心，部分球迷焚烧汽车并实施洗劫。

questions.prompt: Before relocating to Tennessee the Titans franchise had a different name and played here
questions.promptZh: 迁往 Tennessee 之前，Titans 球队使用着另一个名字，并在这座城市效力
questions.story: The Houston Oilers played in Houston from 1960 to 1996 before moving to Nashville; they played the 1997 season in Memphis while waiting for a new stadium.
questions.storyZh: 休斯顿油人队1960至1996年在休斯顿比赛，后迁往纳什维尔；1997赛季他们在孟菲斯过渡一年，等待新球场建成。

questions.prompt: Longtime Rangers goaltender known as 'King Henrik' was born in this Swedish town.
questions.promptZh: 绰号“国王亨利克”的纽约游骑兵队传奇门将出生在这座瑞典小镇。
questions.story: Henrik Lundqvist was born in Åre on March 2, 1982, and backstopped the New York Rangers for 15 seasons, earning the nickname 'King Henrik' and a place in the Hockey Hall of Fame in 2023.
questions.storyZh: 亨里克·伦德奎斯特 1982 年 3 月 2 日出生于奥勒，为纽约游骑兵队把守球门 15 个赛季，绰号“国王亨利克”，2023 年入选冰球名人堂。

questions.prompt: Sidney Crosby grew up in this Nova Scotia community of about 25,000 people
questions.promptZh: 西德尼·克罗斯比在这座约 2.5 万人的新斯科舍社区长大
questions.story: Sidney Crosby was born in Cole Harbour, Nova Scotia, in 1987 and became one of the few NHL players to record a point in every season of his career.
questions.storyZh: 西德尼·克罗斯比 1987 年出生在新斯科舍省科尔港，是 NHL 史上极少数职业生涯每个赛季都有得分记录的球员之一。

questions.prompt: Fans rioted in 1955 after the NHL suspended Canadiens star Maurice 'Rocket' Richard in this city
questions.promptZh: 1955年，NHL 停赛 Canadiens 球星 Maurice “Rocket” Richard 后，这座城市的球迷发生骚乱
questions.story: A furious crowd rioted in Montreal on March 17, 1955, after the NHL suspended Canadiens star Maurice “Rocket” Richard for on-ice violence.
questions.storyZh: 1955年3月17日，NHL因场上冲突停赛了蒙特利尔Canadiens队球星莫里斯“火箭”理查德，引发当地球迷愤怒并发生骚乱。

questions.prompt: This city’s NHL team was founded by Disney in 1993 and named after the studio’s 1992 film.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的 NHL 球队由迪士尼 1993 年创立，以该制片厂 1992 年的电影命名。
questions.story: The Mighty Ducks of Anaheim joined the NHL as an expansion team in 1993–94, owned by The Walt Disney Company and named after its 1992 film The Mighty Ducks; the club became the Anaheim Ducks in 2006.
questions.storyZh: 安纳海姆大力鸭队 1993-94 赛季作为扩军球队加入 NHL，由华特迪士尼公司创立并以 1992 年电影《大力鸭》命名；2006 年更名为安纳海姆鸭队。

questions.prompt: This city's NBA team kept its musical name when the franchise moved to Utah in 1979.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的 NBA 球队 1979 年迁往犹他时保留了它与音乐有关的队名。
questions.story: The New Orleans Jazz joined the NBA in 1974 and relocated to Salt Lake City in 1979, keeping the Jazz name.
questions.storyZh: 新奥尔良爵士队 1974 年加入 NBA，1979 年迁往盐湖城，保留了“爵士”这一队名。

questions.prompt: Gavin McKenna, projected #1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft, was born in this Yukon capital
questions.promptZh: 预计成为2026年NHL选秀状元秀的Gavin McKenna出生在这座Yukon首府
questions.story: Whitehorse is Gavin McKenna’s hometown; the Yukon-born winger was widely projected to be the No. 1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft.
questions.storyZh: 加文·麦肯纳出生于白马市，这位育空省出生的边锋被广泛预测将成为2026年NHL选秀大会状元。

questions.prompt: In 2020, over 85,000 fans watched the Stars and Predators play an outdoor game at a college stadium in this city
questions.promptZh: 2020年，超过85,000名球迷在这座城市的大学体育场观看了Stars与Predators的户外比赛
questions.story: On January 1, 2020, 85,592 fans watched the Dallas Stars defeat the Nashville Predators 4-3 in an outdoor NHL game at Nissan Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 2020年1月1日，共有85,592名球迷在尼桑体育场观看达拉斯星队以4比3击败纳什维尔-predators的户外NHL比赛。

questions.prompt: After 4 years from his 'Golden Goal', Sidney Crosby won his 2nd Olympic gold in this city
questions.promptZh: 在“金球”4年后，Sidney Crosby在这座城市赢得了个人第二枚奥运金牌
questions.story: Sochi hosted the 2014 Winter Olympics, where Canada beat Sweden in the final to retain the men’s hockey title — Sidney Crosby’s second Olympic gold, four years after his “Golden Goal” in Vancouver.
questions.storyZh: 索契举办 2014 年冬奥会，加拿大队在男子冰球决赛击败瑞典队卫冕——这是西尼·克罗斯比的第二枚奥运金牌，距温哥华“金球”四年。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ice hockey at the 2014 Winter Olympics – Men’s tournament

questions.prompt: ESPN has broadcast SportsCenter from its headquarters in this city since 1979
questions.promptZh: ESPN自1979年起一直在其位于这座城市的总部播出SportsCenter
questions.story: SportsCenter premiered on September 7, 1979, the day ESPN launched; the network is headquartered in Bristol, Connecticut.
questions.storyZh: SportsCenter 于 1979 年 9 月 7 日与 ESPN 同日开播；ESPN 总部设在康涅狄格州布里斯托尔。

questions.prompt: Sherpa guides helping climbers tackle the world's highest mountain often begin expeditions from this capital city
questions.promptZh: 帮助登山者攀登世界最高峰的夏尔巴向导，行程常从这座首都城市开始
questions.story: Kathmandu is the traditional launch point for Everest expeditions, with Sherpa mountaineers commonly helping climbers begin their journeys to the world’s highest mountain.
questions.storyZh: 加德满都是珠穆朗玛峰探险的传统出发点，夏尔巴登山者经常协助攀登者从这里启程前往世界最高峰。

questions.prompt: Every Olympic torch relay begins with the flame lit at the ancient site in this European country
questions.promptZh: 每一届奥运火炬传递都从这个欧洲国家的一处古代遗址点燃圣火开始
questions.story: The Olympic flame is lit at Olympia, Greece — the site of the ancient Games — before it is carried by torch relay to the host city. The first modern torch-lighting ceremony took place there in 1936.
questions.storyZh: 奥运圣火在希腊奥林匹亚（古代奥运会举办地）点燃，再由火炬接力送往主办城市；首次现代点火仪式于1936年在此举行。

questions.prompt: The '94 Winter Olympics was the first to be held separately from the Summer Games. They were in this town
questions.promptZh: 1994年冬奥会首次与夏季奥运会分开举办，举办地就是这座小镇
questions.story: Lillehammer hosted the 1994 Winter Olympics, the first Winter Games held independently from the Summer Olympics since the modern movement began.
questions.storyZh: 利勒哈默尔举办了1994年冬季奥运会，这是现代奥林匹克运动会开始以来首次独立于夏季奥运会举办的冬季赛事。

questions.prompt: The last time the US hosted the Olympics was here, in the Winter of 2002
questions.promptZh: 2002年冬季，美国最后一次举办奥运会的地方就在这里
questions.story: Salt Lake City hosted the 2002 Winter Olympics, the most recent Olympic Games held in the United States until Los Angeles hosts in 2028.
questions.storyZh: 盐湖城举办了2002年冬奥会，这是美国迄今最近一次举办的奥运会，下一次将是2028年的洛杉矶。

questions.prompt: In 1980, a team of U.S. college kids upset the unbeaten Soviets at the Olympics in this town
questions.promptZh: 1980年，一支美国大学队在这座小镇的奥运会上击败了保持不败的苏联队
questions.story: On February 22, 1980, the U.S. hockey team beat the undefeated Soviet Union 4–3 in Lake Placid in the famed Miracle on Ice.
questions.storyZh: 1980年2月22日，美国冰球队在普莱西德湖以4比3击败保持不败的苏联队，创造了著名的“冰上奇迹”。

questions.prompt: Charles Leclerc finally won his hometown race in 2024, ending years of heartbreak on the streets of this city
questions.promptZh: Charles Leclerc终于在2024年的家乡之战中获胜，多年心碎终告结束，赛街道穿过这座城市
questions.story: Charles Leclerc finally won his hometown Grand Prix on May 26, 2024, ending years of near misses on Monaco’s streets.
questions.storyZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔终于在2024年5月26日的家乡大奖赛中夺冠，结束了多年来在摩纳哥街道上的遗憾。

questions.prompt: F1's most prestigious race winds through this principality's casino and harbor streets every year
questions.promptZh: F1 最顶级的赛事每年都在这座城邦的赌场与港口街道间穿梭
questions.story: The Monaco Grand Prix, first held in 1929, runs through the streets of Monte Carlo, passing the famous Casino de Monte-Carlo and the harbor. It is considered the crown jewel of Formula 1.
questions.storyZh: 首届摩纳哥大奖赛于 1929 年举行，赛道穿越蒙特卡洛街道，途经著名的蒙特卡洛赌场与港口。它被誉为一级方程式赛车的皇冠明珠。

questions.prompt: This Florida city is home to NASCAR's most famous track
questions.promptZh: 这座佛罗里达州城市拥有 NASCAR 最著名的赛道
questions.story: Daytona Beach is home to Daytona International Speedway, where NASCAR’s most famous race, the Daytona 500, has been held since 1959.
questions.storyZh: 代托纳比奇是代托纳国际赛道的所在地，NASCAR最著名的达代托纳500自1959年起就在这里举行。

questions.prompt: Super Bowl Champion Jordan Mailata played rugby here before he was drafted by the Eagles
questions.promptZh: 超级碗冠军 Jordan Mailata 在被 Eagles 选中前曾在这里打橄榄球
questions.story: Jordan Mailata played rugby in Auckland before the Philadelphia Eagles drafted the 6-foot-8 New Zealander in 2018.
questions.storyZh: 乔丹·迈拉塔曾在奥克兰打橄榄球，之后这位身高6英尺8英寸的新西兰人被费城老鹰队于2018年选中。

questions.prompt: The All Blacks, who perform the 'Haka,' represent this nation. Its capital sits at the bottom of the North Island
questions.promptZh: 表演“Haka”的 All Blacks 代表这个国家，其首都位于北岛最南端
questions.story: Wellington has been New Zealand’s capital since 1865, and the city is a major home of the All Blacks, famous for performing the haka before matches.
questions.storyZh: 惠灵顿自1865年起一直是新西兰首都，也是以赛前表演哈卡舞而闻名的全黑队的重要基地。

sources.title: Wikipedia: New Zealand national rugby union team

questions.prompt: The South Stand at this city's famous rugby sevens tournament is legendary for its beer-soaked party atmosphere.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市著名七人榄球赛的“南看台”以啤酒狂欢氛围闻名于世。
questions.story: First played in 1976, the Hong Kong Sevens is the premier stop on the World Rugby Sevens Series, and its South Stand is famous for fancy-dress fans and thrown beer jugs.
questions.storyZh: 香港七人榄球赛 1976 年创办，是世界橄榄球七人系列赛最负盛名的分站；南看台以奇装异服的球迷和抛掷啤酒杯的狂欢氛围闻名。

questions.prompt: This Kenyan town is the high-altitude training base where Eliud Kipchoge prepared for his record marathons
questions.promptZh: 这座肯尼亚小镇是埃鲁德·基普乔格备战纪录马拉松的高海拔训练基地
questions.story: Eliud Kipchoge trained at a high-altitude camp in Kaptagat, Kenya, and in 2019 clocked 1:59:40 in a specially staged marathon event in Vienna.
questions.storyZh: 埃鲁德·基普乔格在肯尼亚卡普塔加特的高海拔训练营训练，2019年在维也纳一场特别赛事中跑出1小时59分40秒。

questions.prompt: Olympian Louis Zamperini, who survived 47 days at sea in WWII, grew up in this California city
questions.promptZh: 奥运选手路易·赞佩里尼在二战中海上漂流47天幸存，他在这座加州城市长大
questions.story: Louis Zamperini grew up in Torrance, California, and ran the 5,000 metres at the 1936 Berlin Olympics, finishing eighth with a famous final lap. In WWII he survived 47 days adrift at sea before becoming a Japanese prisoner of war.
questions.storyZh: 路易·赞佩里尼在加州托伦斯长大，参加了1936年柏林奥运会5000米比赛并获得第8名（最后一圈创纪录）。二战中他在海上漂流47天后被日军俘虏。

questions.prompt: In the 2010 Olympics, Lindsey Vonn became the first American woman to win downhill gold, racing at this resort
questions.promptZh: 2010年冬奥会上，Lindsey Vonn在这家滑雪场夺得速降金牌，成为首位赢得该项目金牌的美国女选手
questions.story: At Whistler on February 17, 2010, Lindsey Vonn became the first American woman to win Olympic downhill skiing gold.
questions.storyZh: 2010年2月17日，Lindsey Vonn在惠斯勒夺得冬奥会高山速降金牌，成为首位赢得该项目奥运金牌的美国女选手。

questions.prompt: An uncalled handball on the goal line denied the USMNT a likely equalizer in a 2002 World Cup quarterfinal in this city.
questions.promptZh: 2002 年世界杯 1/4 决赛，一次未被吹罚的门线手球让美国队错失扳平机会——比赛在这座城市举行。
questions.story: Germany beat the United States 1–0 in the June 21, 2002 World Cup quarterfinal in Ulsan, a match remembered for an uncalled handball on the goal line.
questions.storyZh: 2002 年 6 月 21 日，世界杯 1/4 决赛在蔚山举行，德国 1-0 击败美国，比赛中一次门线手球未被判罚成为争议焦点。

questions.prompt: Born in Brooklyn, USMNT striker Folarin Balogun moved to England as a baby and grew up in this city
questions.promptZh: 出生于布鲁克林的美国国家队前锋福拉林·巴洛贡婴儿时期移居英格兰，在这座城市长大
questions.story: Folarin Balogun was born in Brooklyn, New York, on July 3, 2001, and moved to England with his parents when he was two months old, growing up in London. He now plays for the United States national team.
questions.storyZh: 福拉林·巴洛贡2001年7月3日出生于纽约布鲁克林，两个月大时随父母移居英格兰，在伦敦长大，现效力于美国国家队。

questions.prompt: Lionel Messi moved from Argentina at 13 to join an academy in this city
questions.promptZh: Lionel Messi 13岁时离开阿根廷，前往这座城市的青训营加盟
questions.story: Barcelona took Lionel Messi into its La Masia academy when he was 13, and he made his official Barça debut there on October 16, 2004.
questions.storyZh: 巴塞罗那在梅西13岁时将他纳入拉马西亚青训营，他于2004年10月16日在那里完成了巴萨一线队正式首秀。

questions.prompt: The 2026 World Cup opens at this historic stadium in the capital of one of the three host nations
questions.promptZh: 2026年世界杯将在三个主办国之一的这座首都城市的历史球场揭幕
questions.story: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is scheduled to open at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City on June 11, with matches also in Guadalajara and Monterrey.
questions.storyZh: 2026年国际足联世界杯定于6月11日在墨西哥城的阿兹特克体育场揭幕，瓜达拉哈拉和蒙特雷也将承办比赛。

questions.prompt: Lionel Messi was born in this Argentine city with a growth-hormone deficiency his club couldn't treat
questions.promptZh: Lionel Messi 出生在这座阿根廷城市，俱乐部无法治疗他的生长激素缺乏症
questions.story: Lionel Messi was born in Rosario on June 24, 1987, and began his youth career with Newell’s Old Boys, where doctors treated his childhood growth-hormone deficiency.
questions.storyZh: 梅西于1987年6月24日出生在罗萨里奥，并在纽维尔老男孩开始青训生涯，俱乐部医生曾治疗他幼年时的生长激素缺乏症。

questions.prompt: Pelé was born in 1940 in this small Brazilian town in Minas Gerais state
questions.promptZh: Pelé于1940年出生在明纳斯吉拉斯州这座巴西小镇
questions.story: Pelé was born in Três Corações on October 23, 1940, and won three World Cups with Brazil; he was known as “O Rei” — the King.
questions.storyZh: 贝利 1940 年 10 月 23 日出生在特雷斯科拉松伊斯，随巴西队三夺世界杯，绰号“球王”（O Rei，意为国王）。

questions.prompt: The only African player to win the Ballon d'Or was born in this capital and later became his country's president
questions.promptZh: 唯一获得金球奖的非洲球员出生在这座首都，后来成为自己国家的总统
questions.story: George Weah was born in Monrovia in 1966, won the 1995 Ballon d'Or and served as Liberia's president from 2018 to 2024.
questions.storyZh: 乔治·维阿1966年出生在利比里亚首都蒙罗维亚，1995年获得金球奖，2018至2024年担任利比里亚总统。

questions.prompt: The 2014 World Cup's opening match was played in this Brazilian city
questions.promptZh: 2014年世界杯揭幕战在这座巴西城市举行
questions.story: São Paulo hosted the opening match of the 2014 FIFA World Cup on June 12, when Brazil defeated Croatia 3–1 at Arena Corinthians. It was the tournament’s first match and the country’s first World Cup opening in 64 years.
questions.storyZh: 2014年6月12日，圣保罗在科林蒂安竞技场主办国际足联世界杯揭幕战，巴西以3比1战胜克罗地亚。这是该届赛事的首场比赛，也是巴西时隔64年再次主办世界杯揭幕战。

questions.prompt: The 1950 Maracanazo, the 'Maracanazo', happened in this Brazilian city
questions.promptZh: 1950年的“马拉卡纳惨案”就发生在这座巴西城市
questions.story: Rio de Janeiro witnessed the “Maracanazo” on July 16, 1950, when Uruguay defeated Brazil 2–1 before a crowd of nearly 200,000. The result remains one of football’s most famous shocks.
questions.storyZh: 1950年7月16日，近20万名观众在里约见证了“马拉卡纳打击”，乌拉圭以2比1击败巴西。这个结果至今仍是足球史上最著名的冷门之一。

questions.prompt: US keeper Tim Howard set a World Cup record with 16 saves in a 2014 knockout match played in this Brazilian city
questions.promptZh: 美国门将Tim Howard在2014年一场淘汰赛中创下16次扑救的世界杯纪录，比赛在这座巴西城市举行
questions.story: Tim Howard made a World Cup record 16 saves against Belgium in Salvador on July 1, 2014; the United States lost 2-1 after extra time.
questions.storyZh: 2014年7月1日，Tim Howard在萨尔瓦多对阵比利时的比赛中创下世界杯单场16次扑救纪录，美国加时以1比2告负。

sources.title: Wikipedia: North, Central American and Caribbean nations at the FIFA World Cup

questions.prompt: Diego Maradona's 'Goal of the Century' was scored in this city in 1986
questions.promptZh: Diego Maradona的“世纪进球”于1986年在这座城市打进
questions.story: Diego Maradona scored his “Goal of the Century” in Mexico City on June 22, 1986, dribbling past several English defenders before finding the net. FIFA later recognized it as the greatest goal of the 20th century.
questions.storyZh: 1986年6月22日，迭戈·马拉多纳在墨西哥城连续晃过多名英格兰后卫后进球得分。被国际足联认定为20世纪最佳进球。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)

questions.prompt: Roberto Baggio's missed penalty in the 1994 World Cup final shootout happened in this American city.
questions.promptZh: 罗伯特·巴乔在 1994 年世界杯决赛点球大战中射失关键点球，就发生在这座美国城市。
questions.story: Brazil beat Italy on penalties after a 0–0 draw at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena on July 17, 1994; Roberto Baggio skied the decisive kick in the shootout.
questions.storyZh: 1994 年 7 月 17 日，世界杯决赛在帕萨迪纳玫瑰碗球场 0-0 战平后点球决胜，巴西击败意大利；巴乔在点球大战中射失了决定性的一球。

questions.prompt: This Italian club's 'Curva Nord' banners hung over this city's stands
questions.promptZh: 这家意大利俱乐部的“Curva Nord”横幅曾悬挂在这座城市的看台上
questions.story: Turin is home to Juventus and its famous Curva Nord supporters, whose choreographed banners have filled the northern stands for decades. The city’s identity is inseparable from the club’s black-and-white tradition.
questions.storyZh: 都灵是尤文图斯的主场，著名的北看台球迷组织“Curva Nord”数十年来用编排有序的横幅装点看台。这座城市与俱乐部的黑白传统密不可分。

questions.prompt: The 2002 World Cup final was held in this Japanese city
questions.promptZh: 2002年世界杯决赛在这座日本城市举行
questions.story: Yokohama Stadium hosted the 2002 FIFA World Cup final on June 30, when Brazil defeated Germany 2–0 for its fifth world title.
questions.storyZh: 2002年6月30日，横滨体育场举行世界杯决赛，巴西以2比0击败德国，赢得第五座世界杯冠军奖杯。

questions.prompt: Arsenal won its first Premier League title in two decades in 2025-26 and plays its home games in this capital
questions.promptZh: 阿森纳在2025-26赛季赢得了时隔二十年的首个英超冠军，并在这座首都城市进行主场比赛
questions.story: Arsenal won the 2025-26 Premier League title, ending a 22-year wait, playing home games at the Emirates Stadium in London.
questions.storyZh: 阿森纳赢得2025-26赛季英超冠军，结束了22年的等待，主场为伦敦的酋长球场。

questions.prompt: Cristiano Ronaldo was born and raised here before leaving at 12 years old
questions.promptZh: Cristiano Ronaldo在这里出生并长大，12岁前离开
questions.story: Cristiano Ronaldo was born in Funchal on February 5, 1985, and left Madeira for Sporting CP at age 12 in 1997.
questions.storyZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多1985年2月5日出生于丰沙尔，1997年12岁时离开马德拉岛加盟葡萄牙体育。

questions.prompt: In 2025, the Dolphins and Commanders played the first NFL regular-season game in this country at a famous football stadium in its capital
questions.promptZh: 2025年，海豚队与指挥官队在首都的著名足球场举行了这个国家首场 NFL 常规赛
questions.story: On November 16, 2025, the Washington Commanders played the Miami Dolphins at the Santiago Bernabéu in Madrid — the first NFL regular-season game held in Spain.
questions.storyZh: 2025年11月16日，华盛顿指挥官队在马德里伯纳乌球场对阵迈阿密海豚队，这是 NFL 首次在西班牙举行常规赛。

questions.prompt: This is the city where the Ajax dynasty of the 1970s was born
questions.promptZh: Ajax的黄金时代诞生于这座城市
questions.story: Amsterdam was the home of Ajax’s celebrated 1970s dynasty, whose team won three consecutive European Cups from 1971 through 1973.
questions.storyZh: 阿姆斯特丹是阿贾克斯辉煌1970年代的主场，这支球队在1971年至1973年间连续三度赢得欧洲冠军杯。

questions.prompt: Total football was invented by a teacher at this school in this Dutch city
questions.promptZh: 全民足球由一位老师在这座荷兰城市的这所学校发明
questions.story: Total Football was introduced in the Dutch city of Narrow by schoolteacher John Langenus, whose classroom experiments helped shape the Netherlands’ distinctive passing style in the 1970s.
questions.storyZh: 荷兰城市诺罗由学校教师约翰·朗赫努斯引入“全能足球”，他的课堂实验帮助塑造了荷兰队在1970年代鲜明的传球风格。

questions.prompt: Diego Maradona, scorer of the 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century' in 1986, grew up near this capital
questions.promptZh: 打进1986年世界杯“上帝之手”和“世纪进球”的Diego Maradona在这座首都附近长大
questions.story: Buenos Aires is where Diego Maradona grew up in the Villa Fiorito neighborhood before becoming the star of Argentina’s 1986 World Cup victory.
questions.storyZh: 迭戈·马拉多纳在布宜诺斯艾利斯的维拉·菲奥里托区长大，后来成为阿根廷赢得1986年世界杯的明星。

questions.prompt: The Running of the Bulls takes place every July during The San Fermín Festival in this European city
questions.promptZh: 奔牛活动每年7月都会在这座欧洲城市的San Fermín Festival期间上演
questions.story: Pamplona’s San Fermín Festival traditionally runs from July 6 to July 14, with the Running of the Bulls taking place each morning at 8:00 a.m.
questions.storyZh: 潘普洛纳的圣费尔明节传统上于7月6日至14日举行，每天早晨8点都会进行奔牛活动。

questions.prompt: Lionel Messi lifted the World Cup for the first time in 2022 in this city known for its futuristic skyline
questions.promptZh: 2022年，Lionel Messi在这座以未来主义天际线闻名的城市首次举起世界杯
questions.story: Lusail Stadium hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup final on 18 December, when Lionel Messi finally lifted the trophy after Argentina’s penalty shootout win over France.
questions.storyZh: 2022年12月18日，卢赛尔体育场举行国际足联世界杯决赛，阿根廷通过点球大战击败法国，梅西终于举起了冠军奖杯。

questions.prompt: The USMNT recorded its best World Cup finish (3rd in 1930) at the inaugural tourney in this South American city
questions.promptZh: 1930年首届世界杯在这座南美城市举行，美国队取得队史世界杯最佳成绩——季军
questions.story: The United States reached the semifinals of the inaugural 1930 World Cup, whose matches were all played in Montevideo — a finish later recognized as third place and still the best result by an American men's team.
questions.storyZh: 美国队闯入1930年首届世界杯四强（该届赛事全部比赛在蒙得维的亚举行），这一成绩后来被认定为季军，至今仍是美国男足的世界杯最佳战绩。

sources.title: Wikipedia: United States at the FIFA World Cup

questions.prompt: The 1994 World Cup final was played in this Californian city
questions.promptZh: 1994年世界杯决赛在这座加利福尼亚州城市举行
questions.story: The Rose Bowl in Pasadena staged the 1994 FIFA World Cup final on 17 July, where Brazil defeated Italy on penalties before 94,194 spectators.
questions.storyZh: 1994年7月17日，帕萨迪纳的玫瑰碗体育场举行国际足联世界杯决赛，巴西在点球大战中击败意大利，现场观众为94,194人。

questions.prompt: The most-attended World Cup match ever drew an officially recorded 173,850 to this city's Maracanã in 1950
questions.promptZh: 1950年，史上观众人数最多的世界杯比赛在这座城市的马拉卡纳体育场举行，官方记录到场173,850人
questions.story: The decisive 1950 World Cup match between Brazil and Uruguay at the Maracanã drew an officially recorded crowd of 173,850 — an all-time high in paid attendance for a football match.
questions.storyZh: 1950年世界杯巴西对乌拉圭的决定性一战在马拉卡纳体育场举行，官方记录观众173,850人，创足球比赛付费入场人数的历史之最。

questions.prompt: Michael Phelps won a record 8 gold medals at the 2008 Summer Olympics, held in this Asian capital
questions.promptZh: Michael Phelps在这座亚洲首都举行的2008年夏季奥运会上创纪录地赢得8枚金牌
questions.story: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Michael Phelps won eight gold medals, breaking Mark Spitz's record of seven golds at a single Games.
questions.storyZh: 2008年北京奥运会上，Michael Phelps独揽八金，打破了Mark Spitz单届七金的纪录。

questions.prompt: Tennis's 1st major of the year has been held in this Victorian capital since 1988
questions.promptZh: 自1988年以来，网球年度首项大满贯赛事一直在这座维多利亚州首府举行
questions.story: The Australian Open has been based in Melbourne since 1988, when the tournament moved from Kooyong to the new Melbourne Park complex.
questions.storyZh: 自1988年澳大利亚网球公开赛从库扬迁至全新的墨尔本公园球场以来，这项赛事一直以墨尔本为举办地。

questions.prompt: Billie Jean King, winner of the 1973 Battle of the Sexes, grew up in this California city
questions.promptZh: 1973年“性别之战”的胜利者比利·简·金在这座加利福尼亚城市长大
questions.story: Billie Jean King was born and raised in Long Beach and beat Bobby Riggs in the 1973 Battle of the Sexes.
questions.storyZh: 比利·简·金在长滩出生长大，并在1973年“性别之战”中击败鲍比·里格斯。

questions.prompt: Men's tennis's all-time leader in Grand Slam singles titles was born in this capital city in 1987
questions.promptZh: 男子网球大满贯单打冠军数历史第一人于1987年出生在这座首都城市
questions.story: Novak Djokovic was born in Belgrade in 1987 and holds the men's record of 24 Grand Slam singles titles.
questions.storyZh: 诺瓦克·德约科维奇1987年出生于贝尔格莱德，以24座大满贯单打冠军保持男子网坛历史纪录。

questions.prompt: Serena and Venus Williams learned tennis on cracked public courts in this city before dominating Wimbledon
questions.promptZh: Serena Williams 和 Venus Williams 是在这座城市的破旧公共球场上学习打网球的，随后统治了 Wimbledon
questions.story: Serena and Venus Williams learned the game on cracked public courts in Compton, developing the skills that later powered both sisters to Wimbledon dominance.
questions.storyZh: 塞雷娜和维纳斯·威廉姆斯曾在康普顿破裂的公共球场上学球，并在那里磨练出后来帮助姐妹俩统治温网的技艺。

questions.prompt: Bjorn Borg won 5 straight Wimbledon titles from 1976-80 and then retired at 25. He's from this European city
questions.promptZh: 比约恩·博格 1976-80 年连续五次夺得温网冠军，25 岁便退役。他来自这座欧洲城市
questions.story: Björn Borg was born in Stockholm and won five consecutive Wimbledon men’s singles titles from 1976 through 1980 before unexpectedly retiring at 25.
questions.storyZh: 比约恩·博格出生于斯德哥尔摩，1976 至 1980 年连续五次夺得温网男单冠军，随后在 25 岁令人意外地退役。

questions.prompt: This city’s Chiefs have won three Super Bowls since 2019: LIV, LVII and LVIII.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的酋长队自 2019 年以来三夺超级碗：第 LIV、LVII、LVIII 届。
questions.story: The franchise began as the Dallas Texans in 1960 under Lamar Hunt and moved to Kansas City in 1963; the Chiefs have won three Super Bowls in the Patrick Mahomes era.
questions.storyZh: 该球队 1960 年以“达拉斯德州人”之名创立，老板是拉马尔·亨特，1963 年迁至堪萨斯城；酋长队在帕特里克·马霍姆斯时代三夺超级碗。

questions.prompt: In 1971, this city's Chiefs lost a double-overtime Christmas Day playoff to the Miami Dolphins
questions.promptZh: 1971年圣诞夜，这座城市的酋长队在季后赛双加时中负于迈阿密海豚队
questions.story: On December 25, 1971, the Kansas City Chiefs lost to the Miami Dolphins 27–24 in double overtime in an AFC playoff game in Kansas City.
questions.storyZh: 1971年12月25日，堪萨斯城酋长队在AFC季后赛中经过双加时以24比27负于迈阿密海豚队。

questions.prompt: This city’s Bills are the only NFL franchise to reach four consecutive Super Bowls.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的比尔队是 NFL 唯一连续四届打进超级碗的球队。
questions.story: The Buffalo Bills reached the Super Bowl after the 1990 through 1993 seasons — a record four straight — but lost them all.
questions.storyZh: 布法罗比尔队在 1990 至 1993 赛季后连续四届打进超级碗（史上唯一），但四场皆负。

questions.prompt: A November 2014 lake-effect storm buried parts of this city under more than 60 inches of snow
questions.promptZh: 2014年11月的一场湖效应暴风雪让这座城市部分地区积雪超过60英寸
questions.story: The November 2014 lake-effect storm dumped more than 60 inches of snow on parts of western New York, including Buffalo.
questions.storyZh: 2014年11月的湖效应暴风雪在纽约州西部部分地区（包括布法罗）降下超过60英寸的积雪。

questions.prompt: This city’s Browns retired number 14 for Otto Graham, who led them to seven NFL championships.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的布朗队为奥托·格拉汉姆退役了 14 号——他率队七夺 NFL 冠军。
questions.story: Otto Graham quarterbacked the Browns to seven league championships in their first 10 seasons, and the club retired his No. 14.
questions.storyZh: 奥托·格拉汉姆在布朗队前 10 个赛季中率队七夺联赛冠军，球队退役了他的 14 号球衣。

questions.prompt: This city's Union Terminal opened in 1930 as a grand railroad station
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的联合车站1930年启用，是一座宏伟的火车站
questions.story: Cleveland Union Terminal, built for the city's railroad lines, was dedicated and opened in 1930; the Browns lost the 1946 NFL title game.
questions.storyZh: 克利夫兰联合车站为全市铁路线而建，1930年正式启用；布朗队则在1946年NFL冠军赛中落败。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Buccaneers, who won Super Bowl XXXVII after the 2002 regular season.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的海盗队赢得2002赛季后的超级碗。
questions.story: Tampa's Buccaneers won Super Bowl XXXVII in January 2003, defeating the Oakland Raiders 48-21.
questions.storyZh: 坦帕海盗队在2003年1月赢得第37届超级碗，以48比21击败奥克兰突袭者队。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Carolina Panthers and has hosted every NFL Draft since 2019.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是黑豹队主场，2019年起连续承办NFL选秀。
questions.story: Charlotte's Bank of America Corporate Center, completed in 1992, became the city's tallest building.
questions.storyZh: 夏洛特美国银行企业中心于1992年建成，后来成为该市最高的建筑。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Bengals, whose quarterback Ken Anderson set a Super Bowl completions record in the 1980s
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是孟加拉虎队的所在地，该队四分卫肯·安德森在1980年代创下超级碗传球完成数纪录
questions.story: Bengals quarterback Ken Anderson completed 25 passes in Super Bowl XVI, a Super Bowl record at the time later broken by Tom Brady.
questions.storyZh: 孟加拉虎队四分卫肯·安德森在第十六届超级碗完成25次传球，创下当时的超级碗纪录，后来被汤姆·布雷迪打破。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Ravens, whose Super Bowl XLVII victory became known as the Blackout Bowl after a power outage stopped play.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是乌鸦队主场，乌鸦队赢下的第 47 届超级碗因停电中断被称为“停电碗”。
questions.story: The Ravens beat the San Francisco 49ers 34–31 in Super Bowl XLVII on February 3, 2013; a partial power outage at the Superdome suspended play for 34 minutes, and Joe Flacco threw three touchdown passes to win MVP.
questions.storyZh: 2013 年 2 月 3 日的第 47 届超级碗，乌鸦队 34-31 击败 49 人队；超级穹顶体育场部分停电导致比赛中断 34 分钟，乔·弗拉科传出 3 记达阵当选 MVP。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Seahawks, whose home stadium is widely recognized as the loudest in the NFL.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是海鹰队主场，其球场以NFL最高音量闻名。
questions.story: The Seahawks won Super Bowl XLVIII in February 2014, beating the Denver Broncos 43–8 at MetLife Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 海鹰队 2014 年 2 月在 MetLife 球场 43-8 击败丹佛野马，赢得第 48 届超级碗。

questions.prompt: The American football team that won Super Bowl XLI has its home in this city, also famous for an annual 500-mile race.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队赢得第41届超级碗，也以每年举行的500英里车赛闻名。
questions.story: The local professional football franchise joined the NFL under its current name in 1953 and relocated to Indiana in 1984.
questions.storyZh: 当地职业橄榄球队于1953年以现用队名加入NFL，并于1984年迁至印第安纳州。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the Broncos, whose stadium sits a full mile above sea level.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是野马队主场，其球场海拔整整一英里。
questions.story: The Broncos won Super Bowl 50 in February 2016, beating the Carolina Panthers 24–10 at Levi’s Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 野马队 2016 年 2 月在李维斯球场 24-10 击败卡罗莱纳黑豹，赢得第 50 届超级碗。

questions.prompt: This city's NFL franchise once counted a future league commissioner among its investors
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的NFL球队曾在投资人中拥有一位未来的联盟总裁
questions.story: Pete Rozelle, NFL commissioner from 1960 to 1989, was a part-owner of the Atlanta Falcons before taking the commissioner job.
questions.storyZh: 1960至1989年担任NFL总裁的皮特·罗泽尔，出任总裁前曾是亚特兰大猎鹰队的小股东。

questions.prompt: This city’s Saints won Super Bowl XLIV in 2010, four years after Hurricane Katrina devastated the city.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的圣徒队在 2010 年赢得第 44 届超级碗，距卡特里娜飓风重创这座城市四年。
questions.story: The Saints beat the Colts 31–17 in Super Bowl XLIV at Sun Life Stadium in Miami Gardens on February 7, 2010 — a morale boost for New Orleans after Katrina.
questions.storyZh: 2010 年 2 月 7 日，圣徒队在迈阿密花园的太阳生活体育场 31-17 击败小马队夺得第 44 届超级碗，为灾后的新奥尔良注入士气。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the Steelers, who have won six Super Bowls and are tied for the most.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是钢人队主场，球队已赢六次超级碗并列历史最多。
questions.story: The Steelers won their sixth championship in Super Bowl LVI on February 11, 2024.
questions.storyZh: 2024年2月11日，钢人队赢得第56届超级碗，拿到队史第六座总冠军。

questions.prompt: This city's Packers won the first two Super Bowls
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的包装工队赢得了前两届超级碗
questions.story: The Green Bay Packers beat the Kansas City Chiefs 35–10 in the first Super Bowl on January 15, 1967, and won the second Super Bowl a year later.
questions.storyZh: 1967年1月15日，绿湾包装工队在首届超级碗中以35比10击败堪萨斯城酋长队，一年后又赢得第二届超级碗。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the Texans, whose stadium was the first NFL venue with a retractable roof
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是德州人队的主场，其体育场是NFL首个可开合屋顶场馆
questions.story: The Texans' stadium opened in 2002 as the first NFL venue with a retractable roof and hosted Super Bowl LI on February 5, 2017, when New England erased a 28–3 deficit to beat Atlanta 34–28 in overtime.
questions.storyZh: 德州人队的体育场于2002年启用，是NFL首个可开合屋顶场馆；2017年2月5日，这里承办了第51届超级碗，新英格兰爱国者队在落后28比3的情况下以34比28加时逆转亚特兰大猎鹰队。

sources.title: Stadiums of Pro Football: Houston stadium

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Cowboys, the NFL’s most valuable franchise, whose name evokes a starry sky.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是牛仔队的家园，该队估值位居全联盟之首。
questions.story: The Dallas Cowboys began play in 1960 and have called AT&T Stadium in nearby Arlington home since 2009.
questions.storyZh: 达拉斯牛仔队于1960年开始参赛，自2009年以来一直以附近的阿灵顿AT&T球场为主场。

questions.prompt: This city’s Eagles won Super Bowl LII in 2018, beating the Patriots behind backup QB Nick Foles.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的鹰队在 2018 年凭借替补四分卫尼克·福尔斯的出色发挥击败爱国者赢得第 52 届超级碗。
questions.story: The Philadelphia Eagles beat the New England Patriots 41–33 in Super Bowl LII on February 4, 2018; backup quarterback Nick Foles was named MVP.

questions.promptZh: 这座北方城市拥有苏丹队，他们已十次夺得联赛冠军。

questions.storyZh: 蒙特雷苏丹队 1939 年成立，十次夺得墨西哥联盟冠军，最近一次是 2018 年。

questions.prompt: This capital hosted the first-ever KBO League game in 1982
questions.promptZh: KBO联赛的首场比赛1982年在这座首都举行
questions.story: The KBO League's inaugural game was played at Dongdaemun Baseball Stadium in Seoul on March 27, 1982, with the Samsung Lions facing the MBC Chungyong.

questions.prompt: The ten-time champion Brothers of the Chinese Professional Baseball League were founded in this capital by the Brother Hotel

questions.storyZh: 现名中信兄弟的球队1984年由兄弟大饭店在台北创立，已十次夺得中华职棒总冠军。

questions.prompt: This domed stadium in Japan's capital has opened the MLB season six times since 2000
questions.promptZh: 这座位于日本首都的巨蛋球场自2000年以来六度承办MLB赛季揭幕战
questions.story: Tokyo Dome hosted Major League Baseball's first regular-season games in Japan in 2000 and has since opened the MLB season six times, most recently with the Dodgers-Cubs series in March 2025.
questions.storyZh: 东京巨蛋在2000年承办了MLB在日本的首场常规赛，此后六度成为MLB赛季揭幕战举办地，最近一次是2025年3月道奇对小熊的系列赛。

questions.prompt: This Arizona town hosts the Chicago club of the National League during spring training.
questions.promptZh: 这个亚利桑那小镇是芝加哥国联球队进行春训的所在地。
questions.story: The Chicago Cubs train each spring at Sloan Park in Mesa, the largest spring-training stadium in Major League Baseball; it opened in 2014.
questions.storyZh: 芝加哥小熊队每年春天在梅萨的斯隆公园训练，该球场 2014 年启用，是 MLB 春训基地中最大的一座。

questions.prompt: This island nation won 25 Baseball World Cups between 1939 and 2005, 22 more than any other country.

questions.story: Cuba dominated the Baseball World Cup, winning 25 titles from 1939 to 2005 — 22 more than the next-closest nation.
questions.storyZh: 古巴长期统治棒球世界杯，1939 至 2005 年共 25 次夺冠，比第二名多 22 次。

questions.prompt: This Caribbean nation has the world's highest number of Major League Baseball players relative to its population.
questions.promptZh: 这个加勒比国家按人口计算的职棒大联盟球员数量居世界首位。
questions.story: More than 300 players from the Dominican Republic have reached Major League Baseball since international amateur signing began in 1996.

questions.prompt: This South American country has produced more than 400 players who later appeared in Major League Baseball.
questions.promptZh: 这个南美国家已输送超过400名MLB球员。
questions.story: More than 400 Venezuelan players have appeared in Major League Baseball, making the country one of baseball's leading talent sources.
questions.storyZh: 超过400名委内瑞拉球员曾出现在美国职业棒球大联盟，使该国成为棒球人才的重要来源。

questions.prompt: Nippon Professional Baseball, whose twelve clubs contest an annual championship series, has been the top pro baseball circuit of this country since 1950
questions.promptZh: 日本职业棒球的十二支球队每年角逐总冠军，这项赛事自1950年起便是该国的顶级棒球联赛
questions.story: Nippon Professional Baseball was formed in 1950, when the Japanese Baseball League reorganized into the Central and Pacific leagues. The Japan Series has been contested every year since, and NPB draws the second-highest season attendance of any baseball league in the world.
questions.storyZh: 日本职业棒球1950年由日本棒球联盟改组而成，分为中央联盟和太平洋联盟。此后每年举行日本大赛，其赛季总观众人数居世界棒球联赛第二位。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Lakers, who won multiple championships in the 1980s behind Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是湖人队主场，1980年代有魔术约翰逊和贾巴尔。
questions.story: The Lakers won five NBA championships during the 1980s, with Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar leading the franchise.
questions.storyZh: 湖人队在1980年代赢得五次NBA总冠军，魔术约翰逊和贾巴尔是球队的核心。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Bulls, who won six titles in the 1990s with Michael Jordan.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是公牛队主场，乔丹时代赢下六个总冠军。
questions.story: The Bulls captured six NBA championships in the 1990s, winning three consecutive titles from 1991 through 1993.
questions.storyZh: 公牛队在1990年代赢得六次NBA总冠军，并在1991年至1993年连续三次夺冠。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Celtics, whose 18 championships are the most in NBA history.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是凯尔特人队主场，拥有NBA历史最多的18次总冠军。
questions.story: The Celtics earned their record-extending 18th NBA championship in 2024, surpassing the league's previous mark.
questions.storyZh: 凯尔特人队在2024年获得队史第18个NBA总冠军，超越了联盟此前的纪录。

questions.prompt: This city's Heat reached four straight NBA Finals from 2011 to 2014, winning back-to-back titles in 2012 and 2013
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的热火队在2011至2014年连续四年闯入NBA总决赛，并在2012和2013年实现两连冠
questions.story: The Miami Heat went to four consecutive NBA Finals from 2011 to 2014, winning back-to-back championships in 2012 and 2013.
questions.storyZh: 迈阿密热火队2011至2014年连续四年闯入NBA总决赛，并在2012和2013年实现两连冠。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the team that won the 2011 NBA title by beating Miami in a six-game Finals.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队2011年以六比四击败迈阿密，赢得NBA总冠军。
questions.story: The Dallas Mavericks won their first NBA championship in 2011, beating the Miami Heat in six games, with Dirk Nowitzki named Finals MVP.
questions.storyZh: 达拉斯独行侠在2011年赢得队史首个NBA总冠军，六场击败迈阿密热火，德克·诺维茨基当选总决赛最有价值球员。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the franchise that won the 2019 NBA title, its first championship in team history.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队2019年赢得NBA总冠军，是队史首个冠军。
questions.story: The Toronto Raptors won their first NBA championship in 2019, with Kawhi Leonard earning Finals MVP in a six-game series against Golden State.
questions.storyZh: 多伦多猛龙在2019年赢得队史首个NBA总冠军，考瓦伊·伦纳德在六场系列赛中当选总决赛最有价值球员。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the team that won five NBA titles built on a passing offense.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队以传球体系五次夺得NBA总冠军。
questions.story: The San Antonio Spurs won five NBA championships between 1999 and 2014, built around Tim Duncan and a passing offense.
questions.storyZh: 圣安东尼奥马刺队在1999至2014年间五夺NBA总冠军，以邓肯为核心、强调团队传球。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the 76ers, who won the NBA championships of 1967 and 1983.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队曾于1967年和1983年两次夺得NBA总冠军。
questions.story: The Philadelphia 76ers won the 1967 title with Wilt Chamberlain as their star and the 1983 title with Moses Malone at center.
questions.storyZh: 费城76人队1967年在威尔特·张伯伦带领下夺冠，1983年又依靠摩西·马龙再夺总冠军。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Suns, whose arena roof is a landmark of desert architecture.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球馆屋顶是沙漠建筑地标，主场球队是太阳队。
questions.story: The Suns have played in their downtown arena since 1992, a copper-clad building whose retractable roof was designed by Ellerbe Becket.
questions.storyZh: 太阳队自1992年起在这座城市市中心的一座球馆主场作战，该建筑由埃勒比·贝克特设计，铜色可开合屋顶很有名。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Trail Blazers, whose passionate fans are known as Rip City.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球迷被称为Rip City，主场是开拓者队。
questions.story: Broadcaster Bill Schonely coined 'Rip City' during a Trail Blazers–Lakers game on February 18, 1971, and the nickname has been tied to the team ever since.
questions.storyZh: 1971 年 2 月 18 日开拓者对阵湖人的比赛中，解说员比尔·肖内利喊出“Rip City”，此后这一绰号一直与球队相伴。

questions.prompt: This city’s Thunder won the 2025 NBA championship, beating the Indiana Pacers in seven games.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的雷霆队在 2025 年 NBA 总决赛七场击败印第安纳步行者队夺冠。
questions.story: The Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Indiana Pacers in seven games in the 2025 NBA Finals to win the franchise’s first title since moving from Seattle in 2008.
questions.storyZh: 俄克拉荷马城雷霆队在 2025 年 NBA 总决赛七场击败步行者队，夺得球队 2008 年从西雅图迁来后的首个总冠军。

questions.prompt: This city’s Bucks won NBA championships 50 years apart, in 1971 and 2021.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的雄鹿队相隔 50 年两夺 NBA 总冠军：1971 年和 2021 年。
questions.story: The Milwaukee Bucks won their first NBA championship in 1971 and their second in 2021 — fifty years apart.
questions.storyZh: 密尔沃基雄鹿队 1971 年首夺 NBA 总冠军，2021 年再度登顶，两次夺冠相隔 50 年。

questions.prompt: The basketball franchise that relocated here from New Orleans in 1979 now competes under the Jazz name.
questions.promptZh: 球队于1979年从新奥尔良迁入这座城市，名为爵士。
questions.story: The Utah Jazz relocated to Salt Lake City from New Orleans in 1979 and have played there since.
questions.storyZh: 犹他爵士队于1979年从新奥尔良迁至盐湖城，并一直在此比赛。

questions.prompt: This city’s NBA team plays at the oldest arena in the league, opened in 1968.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的 NBA 球队主场是联盟最老的球馆，1968 年启用。
questions.story: The New York Knicks have played at Madison Square Garden since it opened in February 1968; it is the oldest arena in the NBA.
questions.storyZh: 纽约尼克斯自 1968 年 2 月麦迪逊广场花园启用以来一直在此作战；它是 NBA 最老的球馆。

questions.prompt: The NBA team based in this borough played its first NBA season in 1976-77, after the ABA merger
questions.promptZh: 这支位于该行政区的球队在1976年ABA并入NBA后开启首个NBA赛季
questions.story: The franchise played its first NBA season in 1976-77 as the New York Nets and moved to Brooklyn in 2012.
questions.storyZh: 该球队在1976至1977赛季以纽约网队身份征战NBA，并于2012年迁入布鲁克林。

questions.prompt: The NBA team associated with this city has competed under the Timberwolves name since 1989.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队以森林狼之名征战NBA。
questions.story: The Minnesota Timberwolves joined the NBA in 1989 and have trained at the Twin Cities Orthopedics Performance Center in Golden Valley since it opened in 2017.
questions.storyZh: 森林狼队于1989年加入NBA，并自2017年起使用位于金谷的双城骨科表现中心。

questions.prompt: This city’s Kings ended a 16-year NBA playoff drought in 2023.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的国王队在 2023 年结束了长达 16 年的 NBA 季后赛荒。
questions.story: The Sacramento Kings returned to the NBA playoffs in 2023, ending the longest postseason drought in major North American sports, which dated to 2006.
questions.storyZh: 萨克拉门托国王队 2023 年重返 NBA 季后赛，终结了北美职业体育史上最长的季后赛荒（自 2006 年起）。

questions.prompt: This city’s Hawks own the NBA’s second-longest title drought, having last won as the St. Louis Hawks in 1958.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的老鹰队拥有 NBA 第二长的冠军荒——上次夺冠还是 1958 年的圣路易斯老鹰。
questions.story: The franchise moved from St. Louis to Atlanta in 1968; its only NBA championship came in 1958 as the St. Louis Hawks.
questions.storyZh: 球队 1968 年从圣路易斯迁至亚特兰大；其唯一的 NBA 总冠军是 1958 年以圣路易斯老鹰之名所得。

questions.prompt: An expansion team called the Bobcats began play in this city in 2004, later reclaiming the Hornets name
questions.promptZh: 一支名为山猫队的扩军球队2004年在这座城市开始比赛，后来重拾黄蜂队名称
questions.story: After the original Hornets moved to New Orleans in 2002, Charlotte received a new expansion team, the Bobcats, in 2004; it renamed itself the Hornets in 2014.
questions.storyZh: 原黄蜂队2002年迁往新奥尔良后，夏洛特2004年迎来扩军球队山猫队，2014年重新启用黄蜂队名称。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the franchise that won the 1978 NBA championship as the Bullets.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队曾以子弹队身份夺得1978年NBA总冠军。
questions.story: The Washington Bullets won the 1978 NBA championship by defeating the Chicago Bulls in seven games.
questions.storyZh: 华盛顿子弹队在七场四胜制的总决赛中击败芝加哥公牛，夺得1978年NBA总冠军。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Pacers, who reached the NBA Finals in 2000.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的步行者队在2000年闯入了NBA总决赛。
questions.story: The Indiana Pacers reached the 2000 NBA Finals and finished one victory short of the championship.
questions.storyZh: 印第安纳步行者队闯入2000年NBA总决赛，距离总冠军仅差一场胜利。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Pistons, whose Bad Boys squads reached three straight NBA Finals.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的活塞队坏小子时期连续三次闯入NBA总决赛。
questions.story: The Bad Boys Pistons reached three consecutive NBA Finals from 1988 through 1990.
questions.storyZh: 坏小子活塞队在1988年至1990年间连续三次打进NBA总决赛。

questions.prompt: This city's NBA franchise, the Magic, came three years after the Virginia Beach Squires folded.
questions.promptZh: 该城的NBA魔术队比弗吉尼亚海滩雄鹿队解散时晚三年创立。
questions.story: The Orlando Magic began NBA play in 1989–90 and have played at the Kia Center since 2010.
questions.storyZh: 奥兰多魔术队在1989至1990赛季开始参加NBA，自2010年以来一直在基亚中心主场比赛。

questions.prompt: This city's NBA team won back-to-back championship titles in 1994 and 1995.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队在1994年和1995年连续夺得总冠军。
questions.story: The Summit opened in Houston in 1975 and closed in 2003 after serving as the Rockets' home arena.
questions.storyZh: 峰顶体育馆于1975年在休斯敦开放，2003年关闭，此前曾作为火箭队的主场。

questions.prompt: This city’s Rizal Memorial Coliseum hosted the 1978 FIBA World Championship, the first held in Asia.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的黎刹纪念球馆举办了 1978 年男篮世锦赛，是该项赛事首次在亚洲举行。
questions.story: The 1978 FIBA World Championship, the first FIBA World Championship held in Asia, was played at Manila’s Rizal Memorial Coliseum and the Araneta Coliseum in nearby Quezon City.
questions.storyZh: 1978 年男篮世锦赛是该项赛事首次在亚洲举行，比赛在马尼拉的黎刹纪念球馆和近郊奎松市的阿拉内塔球馆进行。

questions.prompt: This Australian city's basketball club won NBL titles as the Tigers in the 1990s and again as United in 2018 and 2021
questions.promptZh: 这座澳大利亚城市的篮球队在1990年代以老虎队之名夺得NBL总冠军，又在2018和2021年以联队之名再度夺冠
questions.story: The club now known as Melbourne United entered the National Basketball League in 1984 as the Melbourne Tigers, won two titles in the 1990s, and added championships in 2006, 2008, 2018 and 2021.
questions.storyZh: 现名墨尔本联队的俱乐部1984年以墨尔本老虎队之名加入NBL，1990年代两夺总冠军，此后又在2006、2008、2018和2021年四次夺冠。

questions.prompt: This city’s Wukesong Indoor Stadium hosted the basketball tournament at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的五棵松体育馆承办了 2008 年夏季奥运会篮球比赛。
questions.story: The basketball tournament at the 2008 Summer Olympics was played at Beijing’s Wukesong Indoor Stadium from August 9 to 24.
questions.storyZh: 2008 年夏季奥运会篮球比赛 8 月 9 日至 24 日在北京五棵松体育馆举行。

questions.prompt: The Araneta Coliseum, a main venue of Philippine basketball nicknamed the Big Dome, opened in this city in 1960
questions.promptZh: 绰号“大圆顶”的阿拉内塔体育馆是菲律宾篮球主要场馆，1960年在这座城市开业
questions.story: The Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City, nicknamed the Big Dome, opened in 1960. Its dome was the largest in Asia until 2001, and the arena is a main venue of the Philippine Basketball Association.
questions.storyZh: 位于奎松市的阿拉内塔体育馆绰号“大圆顶”，1960年启用，其穹顶在2001年前为亚洲最大，如今是菲律宾篮球协会的主要比赛场馆。

questions.prompt: This city’s Žalgiris won the 1999 EuroLeague, beating Italian power Kinder Bologna in the final.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的扎尔吉里斯队在 1999 年欧冠决赛击败意大利劲旅博洛尼亚夺冠。
questions.story: Žalgiris Kaunas won the 1999 EuroLeague, defeating Kinder Bologna in the final at the Final Four in Munich.
questions.storyZh: 扎尔吉里斯·考纳斯在慕尼黑四强赛的决赛中击败博洛尼亚，夺得 1999 年欧洲篮球冠军联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This city’s Partizan won the 1992 European League title, edging Joventut Badalona 71–70 in the final.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的游击队 1992 年欧洲联赛决赛 71-70 险胜巴达洛纳尤文图特夺冠。
questions.story: Partizan Belgrade won the 1991–92 FIBA European League, beating Montigalà Joventut 71–70 in the final at the Final Four in Istanbul.
questions.storyZh: 贝尔格莱德游击队在伊斯坦布尔四强赛的决赛中 71-70 击败蒙蒂加拉·尤文图特，夺得 1991-92 赛季欧洲联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This Tuscan city's club won five consecutive Italian league championships from 2007 through 2011
questions.promptZh: 这座托斯卡纳城市的篮球队在2007至2011年豪取五连冠
questions.story: Montepaschi Siena won five consecutive Italian league titles from 2006-07 to 2010-11.
questions.storyZh: 以蒙特帕斯基锡耶纳为名，该队在2006-07至2010-11赛季连夺五届意大利联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This capital hosted the final four of a FIBA Europe basketball championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都曾举办一项欧洲篮球锦标赛的四强赛。
questions.story: Yerevan’s Cascade complex underwent a major restoration between 2011 and 2015.
questions.storyZh: 埃里温的阶梯建筑群在2011年至2015年间进行了全面修复。

questions.prompt: This Nigerian megacity is the birthplace of Hakeem Olajuwon, the first overall pick of the 1984 NBA draft
questions.promptZh: 这座尼日利亚超级城市是1984年NBA选秀状元Hakeem Olajuwon的出生地
questions.story: Hakeem Olajuwon was born in Lagos, Nigeria, in 1963 and was selected first overall by the Houston Rockets in the 1984 NBA Draft.
questions.storyZh: Hakeem Olajuwon 1963年出生在尼日利亚拉各斯，1984年NBA选秀中被休斯顿火箭队用状元签选中。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the first NBA Africa Game in 2015.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市在 2015 年承办了首届 NBA 非洲赛。
questions.story: The first NBA Africa Game was played at Ellis Park Arena in Johannesburg on August 1, 2015, with Team World beating Team Africa 101–97.
questions.storyZh: 首届 NBA 非洲赛 2015 年 8 月 1 日在约翰内斯堡埃利斯公园球馆举行，世界队 101-97 击败非洲队。

questions.prompt: An original AFL franchise that moved here in 1963, this city's team has won three Super Bowls built by GM Brett Veach
questions.promptZh: 这支1963年迁至这座城市的原AFL球队，在总经理Brett Veach打造的阵容下赢得了三座超级碗
questions.story: Founded as the Dallas Texans in 1960, the franchise moved to Kansas City in 1963; general manager Brett Veach constructed the rosters for the club's Super Bowl LIV, LVII and LVIII champions.
questions.storyZh: 该球队1960年以“达拉斯德州人”之名创立，1963年迁至堪萨斯城；总经理Brett Veach为球队第54、57、58届超级碗冠军阵容奠定了基础。

questions.prompt: This city's Chiefs erased a 24–0 deficit to beat the Texans 51–31 in a January 2020 playoff game
questions.promptZh: 2020年1月的季后赛中，这座城市的酋长队在0比24落后的情况下51比31逆转击败德州人队
questions.story: On January 12, 2020, the Kansas City Chiefs trailed the Houston Texans 24–0 in the AFC divisional round before storming back for a 51–31 win.
questions.storyZh: 2020年1月12日，堪萨斯城酋长队在AFC分区轮一度0比24落后休斯敦德州人队，最终以51比31完成逆转。

questions.prompt: This city is home to an NFL team that endured a 17-year postseason drought before returning to the playoffs in 2018.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的NFL队曾陷17年季后赛荒，2018年重返季后赛。
questions.story: The Bills finished the 2018 regular season with a 10-6 record, ending the NFL's longest active playoff drought, and then won a wild-card game in January 2019.
questions.storyZh: 比尔队在2018赛季取得10胜6负，结束了联盟当时持续时间最长的季后赛荒，并于次年一月份赢下一场外卡赛。

questions.prompt: This city's NFL team retired jersey No. 14 for Jim Thorpe, a 1912 Olympic champion
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的NFL球队为1912年奥运冠军吉姆·索普退役了14号球衣
questions.story: The Cleveland Browns retired No. 14 in honor of Jim Thorpe, who won Olympic gold in 1912 and played professional football for Cleveland teams in the 1920s.
questions.storyZh: 克利夫兰布朗队为吉姆·索普退役14号球衣；索普1912年夺得奥运金牌，1920年代曾在克利夫兰的球队打职业橄榄球。

questions.prompt: This city's Browns won the inaugural 1946 AAFC championship in their very first season
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的布朗队在成立首个赛季就赢得了1946年首届 AAFC 冠军
questions.story: The Cleveland Browns went 14-0 in 1946 and won the first AAFC championship, beating the New York Yankees 14-9. Cleveland Union Terminal had opened in 1930 and was one of the world's largest intercity bus terminals.
questions.storyZh: 克利夫兰布朗队1946赛季14战全胜，以14比9击败纽约洋基队夺得首届 AAFC 冠军。克利夫兰联合车站1930年启用，是当时世界最大的城际巴士站之一。

questions.prompt: This Tennessee city hosted the 2019 NFL Draft, where 32 teams made their first-round picks
questions.promptZh: 这座田纳西州城市举办了2019年 NFL 选秀，32支球队在此完成首轮选秀
questions.story: The 2019 NFL Draft was held April 25–27 in Nashville, Tennessee, where all 32 teams made their first-round selections.
questions.storyZh: 2019年 NFL 选秀于4月25至27日在田纳西州纳什维尔举行，32支球队全部完成首轮选人。

questions.prompt: This city's Bengals quarterback threw a perfect passer rating in a 1995 regular-season game
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的孟加拉虎队四分卫在1995年常规赛中打出过满分传球评分
questions.story: On October 19, 1995, Bengals quarterback Jeff Blake threw a perfect 158.3 passer rating in a 27–9 win over Pittsburgh, the only such game in franchise history.
questions.storyZh: 1995年10月19日，孟加拉虎队四分卫杰夫·布莱克在27比9击败钢人队的比赛中打出158.3的满分传球评分，这是队史唯一一次。

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of NFL players who have posted a perfect passer rating

questions.prompt: This city’s Colts won Super Bowl XLI, and it hosts the annual 500-mile race each May.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的小马队赢得第41届超级碗，并承办五月500英里赛。
questions.story: The Colts defeated the Chicago Bears 29-17 in Super Bowl XLI on February 4, 2007.
questions.storyZh: 2007年2月4日，小马队在第41届超级碗中以29比17击败芝加哥熊队。

questions.prompt: This city’s Ravens won Super Bowl XLVII, the game interrupted by a power outage.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的乌鸦队赢得第 47 届超级碗，比赛因停电中断。
questions.story: The Ravens beat the 49ers 34–31 in Super Bowl XLVII on February 3, 2013; a partial power outage suspended play for 34 minutes.
questions.storyZh: 2013 年 2 月 3 日第 47 届超级碗，乌鸦队 34-31 击败 49 人队；部分停电导致比赛中断 34 分钟。

questions.prompt: Fans of this city's NFL team twice set the Guinness record for loudest crowd roar, in 2013 and 2014
questions.promptZh: 这座城市NFL球队的球迷在2013和2014年两次创下吉尼斯最响亮的观众呐喊纪录
questions.story: Seahawks fans at Lumen Field set the Guinness World Record for loudest crowd roar at an outdoor stadium in 2013 and again in 2014.
questions.storyZh: 海鹰队球迷在卢门球场两次创下吉尼斯室外体育场最响观众呐喊纪录，分别在2013和2014年。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Angels, whose 2002 World Series win remains the franchise's only championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是天使队主场，天使队 2002 年世界大赛夺冠，是球队迄今唯一的总冠军。
questions.story: The Angels beat the San Francisco Giants in seven games in the 2002 World Series, the franchise's only title; the team has played at Angel Stadium in Anaheim since 1966.
questions.storyZh: 天使队在 2002 年世界大赛七场大战中击败旧金山巨人队，夺得队史唯一总冠军；球队自 1966 年起在阿纳海姆的天使体育场比赛。

questions.prompt: This city’s Sharks won their first CBA title in 2002, during Yao Ming’s final season before the NBA.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的鲨鱼队在 2002 年首夺 CBA 冠军，那是姚明赴 NBA 前的最后一个赛季。
questions.story: The Shanghai Sharks, led by Yao Ming, reached three straight CBA finals from 2000 to 2002 and won the 2002 title, breaking the Bayi Rockets’ six-year reign.
questions.storyZh: 姚明领衔的上海大鲨鱼 2000 至 2002 年连续三次打进 CBA 总决赛，2002 年首夺冠军，终结八一火箭的六连冠。

questions.prompt: This city’s basketball club completed a triple crown in 2003, winning its league, cup and the EuroLeague.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的篮球队在 2003 年完成三冠王：联赛、杯赛与欧洲联赛。
questions.story: FC Barcelona Bàsquet, founded in 1926 and based in Barcelona, completed a triple crown in 2003 by winning the league, cup and EuroLeague.
questions.storyZh: 巴塞罗那篮球俱乐部 1926 年成立，2003 年包揽联赛、杯赛和欧洲联赛，完成三冠王。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the basketball club that won the 2014 Basketball Bundesliga championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市拥有一家赢得 2014 年德国篮球甲级联赛冠军的俱乐部。
questions.story: FC Bayern Munich's basketball team won its third German title in 2014, beating ALBA Berlin 3–1 in the Basketball Bundesliga Finals.
questions.storyZh: 拜仁慕尼黑篮球队在 2014 年德国篮球甲级联赛总决赛中 3-1 击败 ALBA 柏林，夺得队史第三个德国冠军。

questions.prompt: This city’s Panathinaikos beat hosts Kinder Bologna to win the 2002 EuroLeague title.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的帕纳辛奈科斯队在 2002 年欧冠决赛击败东道主博洛尼亚夺冠。
questions.story: Panathinaikos won the 2002 EuroLeague at the Final Four in Bologna, where Dejan Bodiroga was named MVP.
questions.storyZh: 帕纳辛奈科斯在博洛尼亚举行的 2002 年欧冠四强赛中夺冠，德扬·博迪罗加当选 MVP。

questions.prompt: Benetton Basket, the club backed by the clothing giant founded near this Italian city, reached the 1998 EuroLeague Final Four
questions.promptZh: 由创立于这座意大利城市附近的服装巨头赞助的贝纳通篮球队打进了1998年欧洲篮球联赛四强
questions.story: Benetton Basket of Treviso finished third at the 1998 EuroLeague Final Four in Barcelona; the Benetton Group that backs the club was founded in 1965 in nearby Ponzano Veneto.
questions.storyZh: 特雷维索的贝纳通篮球队在1998年巴塞罗那欧洲篮球联赛四强赛中获得季军；赞助该队的贝纳通集团1965年创立于附近的波扎诺威尼托。

questions.prompt: Basketball club AEL, the only Cypriot club ever to win a European trophy, plays in this island's second-largest city
questions.promptZh: 塞浦路斯唯一赢得过欧洲奖杯的篮球俱乐部AEL在这座岛屿的第二大城市打球
questions.story: AEL Limassol won the FIBA Europe Regional Challenge Cup in 2003, the only European trophy ever won by a sports club from Cyprus.
questions.storyZh: AEL利马索尔队在2003年夺得FIBA欧洲区域挑战杯，是塞浦路斯唯一赢得过欧洲奖杯的体育俱乐部。

questions.prompt: This Balkan capital is home to a basketball club that reached the 1999 EuroCup final.
questions.promptZh: 这座巴尔干首都的球队曾打进1999年欧洲杯决赛。
questions.story: CSKA Sofia defeated Kinder Bologna 92–82 in the EuroCup final to claim the 1999 title.
questions.storyZh: 索菲亚中央陆军队在欧洲杯决赛中以92比82击败金德博洛尼亚，夺得1999年冠军。

questions.prompt: This Midwestern city's team, nicknamed Hockeytown, has won 11 Stanley Cups and moved into a new downtown arena in 2017
questions.promptZh: “冰球之城”的球队赢得过11次斯坦利杯，并于2017年迁入市中心新球馆
questions.story: The Detroit Red Wings have won 11 Stanley Cups, the most of any U.S.-based NHL franchise, and began playing at Little Caesars Arena in 2017.
questions.storyZh: 底特律红翼队11次夺得斯坦利杯，是美国NHL球队中最多；球队2017年起在小凯撒竞技场比赛。

questions.prompt: This city's Canadiens won the 1976 Stanley Cup, their first in 41 years
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的加拿大人队赢得了 1976 年斯坦利杯，这是球队 41 年来的首个冠军
questions.story: The Montreal Canadiens defeated the Philadelphia Flyers to win the 1976 Stanley Cup — their first since 1935. The franchise holds the NHL record with 24 championships overall.
questions.storyZh: 蒙特利尔加拿大人队在 1976 年击败费城飞人队夺得斯坦利杯，这是球队自 1935 年以来的首冠。该队以 24 次夺冠保持着 NHL 总冠军纪录。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Maple Leafs, a hockey club originally called the St. Patricks.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的主队原名圣帕特里克队，后来以枫叶队闻名。
questions.story: The team adopted the Maple Leafs name in 1927 and has won 13 Stanley Cups.
questions.storyZh: 该队在1927年改名为枫叶队，此后共赢得13次斯坦利杯。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Rangers, whose home arena overlooks the city's famed public square.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是流浪者队主场，其球馆俯瞰市内著名公共广场。
questions.story: The Rangers have occupied Madison Square Garden since 1995 and hosted outdoor NHL games there in 1998, 2000, 2003, and 2012.
questions.storyZh: 流浪者队自1995年起使用麦迪逊广场花园，并曾于1998年、2000年、2003年和2012年在那里举办户外冰球赛。

questions.prompt: The Blackhawks ended a 49-year wait in this city by winning the 2010 Stanley Cup.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的黑鹰队结束49年等待，夺得2010年斯坦利杯。
questions.story: The Blackhawks won the 2010 Stanley Cup — their first title since 1961 — and added more in 2013 and 2015.
questions.storyZh: 黑鹰队 2010 年夺得斯坦利杯，终结自 1961 年以来的等待，并在 2013、2015 年再夺冠。

questions.prompt: The Bruins won the 2011 Stanley Cup in this city during the league's 100th season.
questions.promptZh: 百周年赛季，棕熊队在这座城市夺得2011年斯坦利杯。
questions.story: Boston has hosted the NHL All-Star Game three times, in 1974, 1990, and 1996.
questions.storyZh: 波士顿分别于1974年、1990年和1996年三次举办NHL全明星赛。

questions.prompt: The Flyers won consecutive Stanley Cups in this city in 1974 and 1975.
questions.promptZh: 飞鹰队在这座城市连夺1974年和1975年斯坦利杯。
questions.story: Philadelphia hosted the NHL All-Star Game in 1976, 1978, 1992, and 2016.
questions.storyZh: 费城分别于1976年、1978年、1992年和2016年举办NHL全明星赛。

questions.prompt: The Penguins won the 1991 Stanley Cup in this city, sweeping the final four games without conceding a goal.
questions.promptZh: 企鹅队在这座城市赢得1991年斯坦利杯，决赛四场均未失球。
questions.story: Pittsburgh's Civic Arena hosted the NHL All-Star Game in 1991 and 1992.
questions.storyZh: 匹兹堡的市政竞技场曾于1991年和1992年举办NHL全明星赛。

questions.prompt: The Oilers play in this Alberta city, the provincial capital and gateway to the northern oil sands
questions.promptZh: 油人队在这座阿尔伯塔城市打球，它是省会，也是通往北方油砂区的门户
questions.story: Edmonton, Alberta's capital, is known as the 'Gateway to the North' and serves as the service and supply centre for Alberta's oil industry, including the northern oil sands.
questions.storyZh: 埃德蒙顿是阿尔伯塔省省会，被称为“北方门户”，是包括北方油砂区在内的全省石油产业的服务与供给中心。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the 2010 Winter Olympics, where Canada's women won hockey gold on home ice
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办了 2010 年冬奥会，加拿大女子冰球队在主场夺金
questions.story: At the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Canadian women's ice hockey team defeated the United States on home ice to win the gold medal. Sapporo (1972) and Nagano (1998) had already hosted Winter Olympics outside Europe before Vancouver.
questions.storyZh: 2010 年温哥华冬奥会上，加拿大女子冰球队在主场击败美国队夺得金牌。札幌（1972）和长野（1998）已先于温哥华在欧洲以外举办过冬奥会。

questions.prompt: This city became the home of a team that returned to the NHL in 2011 after a fifteen-year absence.
questions.promptZh: 球队在结束15年空窗后，于2011年重返NHL并来到这座城市。
questions.story: The current Winnipeg Jets franchise was based in Atlanta from 1997 until moving to Winnipeg in 2011. The club's original Winnipeg incarnation played in the NHL from 1979 to 1996.
questions.storyZh: 现温尼伯喷气机队曾在亚特兰大停留至2011年，随后迁回温尼伯。最初的温尼伯喷气机队曾于1979年至1996年在NHL效力。

questions.prompt: This city is home to a hockey club whose predecessor won the Stanley Cup in 1920.
questions.promptZh: 球队前身在1920年赢得斯坦利杯，这座城市是其主场。
questions.story: The original Ottawa Senators won the Stanley Cup in 1920 after defeating the Seattle Metropolitans in the final. The present-day Senators franchise began playing in 1992.
questions.storyZh: 最初的渥太华参议员队在1920年决赛中击败西雅图都会队，赢得斯坦利杯。现有参议员队则于1992年开始征战。

questions.prompt: This city's former NHL franchise, the Nordiques, relocated to Denver in 1995 and became the Avalanche
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的前 NHL 球队北部人队于 1995 年迁往丹佛，成为雪崩队
questions.story: The Quebec Nordiques played in the NHL from 1979 to 1995 before relocating to Denver, where they became the Colorado Avalanche. Wayne Gretzky won the 1983 Hart Trophy.
questions.storyZh: 魁北克北部人队1979年至1995年征战NHL，后迁往丹佛成为科罗拉多雪崩队；韦恩·格雷茨基获得了1983年哈特奖。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the NHL's newest expansion franchise, which began play in 2000.
questions.promptZh: NHL最新扩张球队于2000年开赛，主场在这座城市。
questions.story: The Columbus Blue Jackets began NHL play in 2000 as one of the league's two expansion clubs admitted in 1999. They were established with the support of Ohio's hockey community.
questions.storyZh: 哥伦布蓝 Jacket 队于2000年首次征战NHL，是联盟1999年接纳的两支扩张球队之一。球队成立时获得了俄亥俄州冰球社群的支持。

questions.prompt: This city has been home to an NHL expansion team since 1998, the Predators
questions.promptZh: 这座城市自1998年起拥有NHL扩军球队捕食者队
questions.story: The Nashville Predators were founded as an expansion franchise in 1997 and began play in 1998–99; they did not relocate from Atlanta.
questions.storyZh: 纳什维尔捕食者队1997年作为扩军球队成立，1998-99赛季开始征战；球队并非从亚特兰大迁来。

questions.prompt: This city is home to a hockey team that relocated from Minnesota and began play here in 1993.
questions.promptZh: 球队1993年从明尼苏达迁来，主场就在这座城市。
questions.story: The Minnesota North Stars relocated to Dallas in 1993 and adopted the Stars name that season. The team has continued playing in the Dallas area since then.
questions.storyZh: 明尼苏达北方星队于1993年迁至达拉斯，并在当赛季改名为达拉斯星队。此后球队一直留在达拉斯地区参赛。

questions.prompt: This city became home to the NHL's 2007 Stanley Cup champions, who are known as the Ducks.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是2007年斯坦利杯冠军“鸭队”的主场。
questions.story: Anaheim's Honda Center opened in 1993 and has a seating capacity of about 17,500.
questions.storyZh: 阿纳海姆的本田中心球馆于1993年开放，座位容量约为17500个。

questions.prompt: This city's NHL expansion team, the Kraken, began play in 2021
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的 NHL 扩充球队克拉肯队于 2021 年开始征战
questions.story: The Seattle Kraken joined the NHL as an expansion team in 2021 and reached the playoffs in their second season.
questions.storyZh: 西雅图克拉肯队2021年以扩充球队身份加入NHL，并在第二个赛季闯入季后赛。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Flames, who won the 1989 Stanley Cup as an Alberta team.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是1989年斯坦利杯冠军“火焰队”的主场。
questions.story: The Flames won the 1989 Stanley Cup, the franchise’s first and only title; the team had moved from Atlanta to Calgary in 1980.
questions.storyZh: 火焰队 1989 年夺得队史首座也是唯一一座斯坦利杯；球队 1980 年从亚特兰大迁至卡尔加里。

questions.prompt: This capital hosted the ice hockey tournament at the 1920 Olympics, which was also recognized as the first IIHF World Championship
questions.promptZh: 这座首都承办了 1920 年奥运会冰球比赛，该赛事也被认定为首届 IIHF 世界锦标赛
questions.story: The 1920 Olympic ice hockey tournament in Antwerp, Belgium, served as the first IIHF World Championship. Stockholm later hosted the IIHF World Championship in 1933, 1949, 1953, 1963, 1970 and 1981. Birger Jarl is traditionally credited with founding Stockholm around 1252.
questions.storyZh: 1920 年在比利时安特卫普举行的奥运冰球赛兼首届 IIHF 世界锦标赛。斯德哥尔摩随后多次承办世锦赛（1933、1949、1953、1963、1970、1981）。Birger Jarl 传统上被视为 1252 年左右建立斯德哥尔摩的奠基人。

questions.prompt: This capital’s CSKA hockey club — the “Red Army team” — has won more Soviet championships than any other.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都的 CSKA 冰球队——“红军”——夺得的苏联联赛冠军比任何球队都多。
questions.story: HC CSKA Moscow, known in the West as the Red Army team, won more Soviet championships and European Cups than any other club and has added KHL Gagarin Cups in 2019, 2022 and 2023.
questions.storyZh: 莫斯科中央陆军冰球俱乐部在西方被称为“红军”，夺得的苏联冠军和欧洲冠军杯数量为各队之最，近年又在 2019、2022、2023 年三夺 KHL 加加林杯。

questions.prompt: This capital’s national team won the 1998 IIHF World Championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都的国家队赢得了 1998 年 IIHF 世界锦标赛冠军。
questions.story: The Czech Republic, whose capital is Prague, won the 1998 IIHF World Championship, held in Switzerland.
questions.storyZh: 首都为布拉格的捷克共和国夺得了 1998 年在瑞士举行的 IIHF 世锦赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This capital hosted the Ice Hockey World Championships in both 1952 and 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都曾在1952年和2022年举办冰球世锦赛。
questions.story: Helsinki was designated a European Capital of Culture in 2000.
questions.storyZh: 赫尔辛基于2000年获评为欧洲文化之都。

questions.prompt: This city's pro hockey club won German ice hockey championships in 1951, 1952 and 2003
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的职业冰球队在1951、1952和2003年三夺德国冰球冠军
questions.story: The Krefeld Pinguine have won the German championship three times, in 1951, 1952 and 2003 — the last of those in the DEL era.
questions.storyZh: 克雷费尔德企鹅队曾三夺德国冰球冠军（1951、1952、2003年），其中2003年一冠是在DEL时代。

questions.prompt: This German city's pro hockey club reached the 1997 final of Germany's top ice hockey league
questions.promptZh: 这座德国城市的职业冰球队打进了1997年德国顶级冰球联赛决赛
questions.story: The Kassel Huskies finished runners-up in Germany's top ice hockey league, the DEL, in 1997. The club has also won second-tier championships in 2008 and 2016.
questions.storyZh: 卡塞尔哈士奇队1997年获得德国顶级冰球联赛DEL亚军，此外还在2008年和2016年两夺次级联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This city’s team won consecutive Stanley Cup championships in 2020 and 2021.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队连续赢得2020年、2021年斯坦利杯。
questions.story: The Tampa Bay Lightning won back-to-back Stanley Cups in 2020 and 2021, beating the Dallas Stars and Montreal Canadiens in the finals.
questions.storyZh: 坦帕湾闪电队2020和2021年连续夺得斯坦利杯，决赛分别击败达拉斯星队和蒙特利尔加拿大人队。

questions.prompt: This Delaware city’s minor-league baseball team is known as the Blue Rocks.

questions.promptZh: 这个国家举办了2022年世界杯，是首次在中东举办的世界杯

questions.prompt: This city hosted the FIFA World Cup finals in 1970 and 1986.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市承办了1970年和1986年的世界杯决赛。
questions.story: Estadio Azteca hosted the 1970 final and, 16 years later, the 1986 final.
questions.storyZh: 阿兹特克体育场先后承办了1970年和1986年的世界杯决赛。

questions.prompt: This city staged the inaugural men's FIFA World Cup final in 1930.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办了1930年首届世界杯决赛。

questions.storyZh: 1930年世界杯决赛在世纪球场举行，乌拉圭以4比2战胜阿根廷。

questions.prompt: This city staged the 1990 FIFA World Cup final between West Germany and Argentina.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办了1990年世界杯决赛。
questions.story: West Germany beat Argentina 1–0 in the 1990 final, with Lothar Matthäus scoring the decisive penalty.
questions.storyZh: 在1990年决赛中，西德队以1比0击败阿根廷队，罚入制胜点球的是洛塔尔·马特乌斯。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the 2004 Summer Olympics, where Argentina's footballers won gold without conceding a goal.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办了 2004 年夏季奥运会，阿根廷男足全程零失球夺得金牌。
questions.story: Athens staged the 2004 Summer Olympics, and Argentina's men won the football gold medal without conceding a single goal in the tournament.
questions.storyZh: 雅典举办 2004 年夏季奥运会，阿根廷男足全程一球未失赢得奥运金牌。

questions.prompt: This city is home to Red Star and Partizan, whose eternal derby predates the country's independence.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的红星与游击队之间的永恒德比，早于国家独立。
questions.story: Red Star and Partizan first met in the eternal derby in 1947, and their rivalry has continued through multiple national names and political systems.
questions.storyZh: 红星与游击队于1947年首次在永恒德比中交锋，此后经历多个国名与政治体制仍延续。

questions.prompt: The only Croatian club to win a European trophy — the 1967 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup — plays in this city
questions.promptZh: 唯一赢得过欧洲赛事奖杯（1967年国际城市博览会杯）的克罗地亚俱乐部来自这座城市
questions.story: Dinamo Zagreb defeated Leeds United in the 1966–67 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup final — to this day the only European trophy won by a Croatian club.
questions.storyZh: 萨格勒布迪纳摩在1966-67赛季国际城市博览会杯决赛中击败利兹联夺冠，至今仍是克罗地亚俱乐部赢得的唯一一座欧洲奖杯。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the club that won the European Cup Winners' Cup in 1975 and 1986.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市拥有一家在 1975 年和 1986 年两夺欧洲优胜者杯的俱乐部。
questions.story: Dynamo Kyiv won the European Cup Winners' Cup in 1975, beating Ferencváros 3–0, and again in 1986, beating Atlético Madrid 3–0.
questions.storyZh: 迪纳摩基辅 1975 年决赛 3-0 击败费伦茨瓦罗斯，1986 年决赛 3-0 击败马德里竞技，两夺欧洲优胜者杯。
