questions.prompt: This city is home to two major rival clubs, Levski and CSKA.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市拥有莱夫斯基与中央陆军两家主要俱乐部。
questions.story: Levski and CSKA contest the Eternal derby, one of the most intense club rivalries in Bulgarian football.
questions.storyZh: 莱夫斯基与中央陆军争夺永恒德比，这是保加利亚足球中最激烈的俱乐部对抗之一。

questions.prompt: This capital was besieged during the 1992–95 war, and its club won the 1967 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都曾在战争中遭围困，其俱乐部赢得过欧洲优胜者杯。
questions.story: The siege of this capital lasted 1,425 days from April 1992 to February 1996, while its club won the 1967 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup.
questions.storyZh: 这座首都的围城战从1992年4月至1996年2月持续1425天，其俱乐部则赢得了1967年欧洲优胜者杯。

questions.prompt: This Eastern European city is home to BATE, which won 17 consecutive Belarusian league titles.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的主场球队BATE曾连续17次夺得联赛冠军。
questions.story: Dinamo Minsk won the Soviet Top League in 1985 and 1986.
questions.storyZh: 明斯克迪纳摩队曾于1985年和1986年夺得苏联顶级联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This Caucasus capital is home to the club that won the 1981 Cup Winners' Cup, named after the city itself
questions.promptZh: 这座高加索首都的第比利斯迪纳摩夺得了1981年欧洲优胜者杯
questions.story: Dinamo Tbilisi beat Carl Zeiss Jena 2–1 in the 1981 Cup Winners' Cup final in Düsseldorf.
questions.storyZh: 第比利斯迪纳摩在杜塞尔多夫举行的1981年欧洲优胜者杯决赛中2比1击败耶拿卡尔·蔡司夺冠。

questions.prompt: Point to this West African megacity, where Hakeem Olajuwon was born before moving to the United States
questions.promptZh: 指向这座西非大都市，哈基姆·奥拉朱旺在此出生后移居美国
questions.story: Lagos is the birthplace of Hakeem Olajuwon, who began playing basketball at 15 and later became the NBA's all-time blocks leader.
questions.storyZh: 拉各斯是哈基姆·奥拉朱旺的出生地，他15岁才开始打篮球，后来成为NBA历史盖帽王。

questions.prompt: This city is the capital of a Central African nation whose club TP Mazembe became the first African side to reach the Club World Cup final in 2010.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是一个中非国家的首都，该国的 TP 马赞比队在 2010 年成为首支打进世俱杯决赛的非洲球队。
questions.story: TP Mazembe, from Lubumbashi in the DR Congo, reached the 2010 FIFA Club World Cup final — the first African club to get that far — losing 3–0 to Inter Milan.
questions.storyZh: 来自刚果（金）卢本巴希的 TP 马赞比队，在 2010 年世俱杯成为首支打进决赛的非洲球队，最终 0-3 负于国际米兰。

questions.prompt: This West African capital was the base of the senior national team that reached three FIFA World Cups
questions.promptZh: 这座西非首都是打进三届世界杯的成年国家队的主场城市
questions.story: Ghana's senior national team qualified for the FIFA World Cup in 2006, 2010 and 2022, and won the Africa Cup of Nations four times.
questions.storyZh: 加纳成年国家队三次打进世界杯（2006、2010、2022），并四度夺得非洲国家杯冠军。

questions.prompt: This West African city is the commercial capital of a nation and is home to ASEC Mimosas, winners of the 1998 CAF Champions League.
questions.promptZh: 这座西非经济中心的ASEC队夺下1998年非洲俱乐部杯。
questions.story: ASEC Mimosas was founded in 1947 and plays at Stade Félix Houphouët-Boigny.
questions.storyZh: ASEC米莫萨队成立于1947年，主场为费利克斯·乌弗埃博伊尼球场。

questions.prompt: This capital’s national team became the first African side to reach a World Cup semifinal in 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都的国家队在 2022 年成为首支打进世界杯四强的非洲球队。
questions.story: Morocco’s Atlas Lions, who play their home matches in Rabat, became the first African and first Arab team to reach a World Cup semifinal at the 2022 tournament.
questions.storyZh: 摩洛哥“阿特拉斯雄狮”以拉巴特为主场，在 2022 年世界杯成为首支闯入四强的非洲及阿拉伯球队。

questions.prompt: This capital hosted the 2014 match where the host nation ended Mexico's long home undefeated streak.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都曾凭2014年世界杯一战终结墨西哥主场不败。
questions.story: In Algiers, the 3–1 victory over Mexico on 13 June 2014 ended a 68-match home undefeated streak, with Sofiane Feghouli scoring twice.
questions.storyZh: 2014年6月13日，阿尔及尔以3比1战胜墨西哥，终结了对手连续68场主场不败的纪录，索菲安·费古利梅开二度。

questions.prompt: This capital’s World Cup stadium hosted the 2002 opening match, where Senegal beat holders France.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都的世界杯球场举办了 2002 年揭幕战，塞内加尔击败卫冕冠军法国。
questions.story: Seoul World Cup Stadium, built for the tournament, hosted the 2002 opener — Senegal’s 1–0 upset of defending champions France — and a semifinal between South Korea and Germany.
questions.storyZh: 为首尔世界杯而建的首尔世界杯球场承办了 2002 年揭幕战（塞内加尔 1-0 爆冷胜法国）以及韩国对德国的半决赛。

questions.prompt: This city’s stadium hosted the 2002 FIFA World Cup final, where Brazil beat Germany 2–0.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球场举办了 2002 年世界杯决赛，巴西 2-0 击败德国。
questions.story: The 2002 World Cup final was played at the International Stadium in Yokohama on June 30, 2002, with Brazil beating Germany 2–0 for a record fifth title.
questions.storyZh: 2002 年 6 月 30 日，世界杯决赛在横滨国际体育场举行，巴西 2-0 击败德国，创下五次夺冠的纪录。

questions.prompt: This port city’s F. Marinos have won the J-League title five times.
questions.promptZh: 这座港口城市的横滨水手队五次夺得 J 联赛冠军。
questions.story: Yokohama F. Marinos, founded as Nissan Motor’s company team and based in Yokohama, have won five J-League titles.
questions.storyZh: 横滨水手以日产汽车厂队起家、主场在横滨，已五次夺得 J 联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This capital is home to Muangthong United, who reached the AFC Champions League semi-finals.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都的主场球队曾打进亚冠半决赛。
questions.story: Bangkok has served as Thailand's capital since 1782, and its historic centre became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023.
questions.storyZh: 自1782年以来，曼谷一直是泰国首都，其历史中心于2023年成为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

questions.prompt: This city is the Indonesian capital whose clubs reached the AFC Champions League final twice.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是印度尼西亚首都，俱乐部曾两次闯入亚冠联赛决赛。
questions.story: Persija reached the 1994 Asian Club Championship final, while Pelita Jaya contested the 1983 final after winning the 1982 title.
questions.storyZh: 佩尔吉亚进入1994年亚洲俱乐部锦标赛决赛，佩利塔再也曾夺得1982年冠军并闯入1983年决赛。

questions.prompt: The OFC champion from this city lost 2–1 to Egypt’s Al Ahly at the 2005 FIFA Club World Championship in Japan.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的球队作为大洋洲冠军，在 2005 年日本世俱杯 1-2 负于埃及阿赫利。
questions.story: Sydney FC, the OFC representative, lost 2–1 to Al Ahly in the quarter-finals of the 2005 FIFA Club World Championship, hosted in Japan and won by São Paulo.
questions.storyZh: 作为大洋洲代表的悉尼 FC 在 2005 年日本世俱杯 1/4 决赛 1-2 负于阿赫利；该届冠军是圣保罗。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the club that repeatedly won the OFC Champions League.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的俱乐部多次赢得大洋洲冠军联赛。
questions.story: Auckland City won seven OFC Champions League titles between 2009 and 2018.
questions.storyZh: 奥克兰城在2009年至2018年间七次夺得大洋洲冠军联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This city’s metropolitan area hosted the 1999 Women’s World Cup final at the Rose Bowl, where the USA beat China on penalties.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的都会区在玫瑰碗球场举办了 1999 年女足世界杯决赛，美国队点球击败中国队。
questions.story: The 1999 Women’s World Cup final at the Rose Bowl drew 90,185 fans — a record for a women’s sporting event — and the USA beat China 5–4 on penalties after a 0–0 draw.
questions.storyZh: 1999 年女足世界杯决赛在玫瑰碗球场吸引 90,185 名观众，创下女子体育赛事纪录；美国队 0-0 战平后点球 5-4 击败中国队。

questions.prompt: This Scottish city hosted the 1960 European Cup final, won 7-3 by Real Madrid
questions.promptZh: 这座苏格兰城市举办了1960年欧洲冠军杯决赛，皇马以7比3获胜
questions.story: Real Madrid beat Eintracht Frankfurt 7-3 in the 1960 European Cup final at Hampden Park in Glasgow, watched by over 127,000 fans.
questions.storyZh: 1960年欧洲冠军杯决赛在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，皇家马德里7比3击败法兰克福，现场观众超过12.7万人。

questions.prompt: The 1998 World Cup final was played here, where France defeated Brazil 3–0.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市曾举办1998年世界杯决赛，法国3比0击败巴西。
questions.story: France beat Brazil 3–0 in the 1998 World Cup final at the Stade de France, with two Zinédine Zidane headers; the match followed a pre-match scare over Ronaldo’s fitness.
questions.storyZh: 1998 年世界杯决赛在法兰西体育场举行，法国队 3-0 击败巴西队，齐达内两次头球破门；赛前罗纳尔多的身体状况一度引发风波。

questions.prompt: This Russian city was renamed Sverdlovsk in 1924 and hosted matches at the 2018 World Cup
questions.promptZh: 这座俄罗斯城市1924年更名为斯维尔德洛夫斯克，并举办了2018年世界杯比赛
questions.story: Yekaterinburg was renamed Sverdlovsk in 1924 and regained its original name in 1991; it hosted four matches at the 2018 FIFA World Cup.
questions.storyZh: 叶卡捷琳堡1924年更名为斯维尔德洛夫斯克，1991年恢复原名；2018年世界杯在此举办四场比赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosted a 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup semi-final on 25 June, where the home side reached the final.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市承办2017年联合会杯半决赛，东道主闯入决赛。
questions.story: In 2005, the city celebrated its millennium, and the Kazan Kremlin was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List.
questions.storyZh: 2005年，这座城市庆祝建城一千年，喀山克里姆林宫同年被列入世界遗产名录。

questions.prompt: This Russian city is home to Zenit, winners of the 2008 UEFA Cup and the 2008 UEFA Super Cup
questions.promptZh: 这座俄罗斯城市是泽尼特队的所在地，该队夺得了2008年欧洲联盟杯和欧洲超级杯
questions.story: Zenit St Petersburg won the 2008 UEFA Cup and went on to claim the 2008 UEFA Super Cup, the first Russian club to lift either trophy.
questions.storyZh: 圣彼得堡泽尼特队2008年夺得欧洲联盟杯，随后又赢得欧洲超级杯，是首支捧起这两座奖杯的俄罗斯俱乐部。

questions.prompt: This city is home to the Masters Tournament, where the champion receives a green jacket
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是大师赛的举办地，冠军将获得绿夹克
questions.story: The Masters Tournament has been played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, since 1934 (except 1943–45). The tournament was co-founded by Bobby Jones and Clifford Roberts; the champion receives a green jacket.
questions.storyZh: 大师赛自 1934 年起（1943-45 年停办除外）每年在佐治亚州奥古斯塔的奥古斯塔国家高尔夫俱乐部举行。赛事由鲍比·琼斯与克利福德·罗伯茨共同创办；冠军获得绿夹克。

questions.prompt: This town is home to the Old Course, the spiritual home of The Open Championship
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇拥有老球场，是英国公开赛的精神家园
questions.story: The Old Course at St Andrews is the most storied venue in golf and has hosted The Open Championship since 1873. The university town is widely regarded as the home of the sport.
questions.storyZh: 圣安德鲁斯老球场是高尔夫史上最具传奇色彩的场地，自 1873 年起承办英国公开赛。这座大学城被普遍视为高尔夫运动的发源地。

questions.prompt: This Monterey Peninsula town hosts the AT&T Pro-Am, the PGA Tour’s famous celebrity tournament, each February.
questions.promptZh: 这座蒙特雷半岛小镇每年二月举办 PGA 巡回赛著名的名人职业-业余配对赛 AT&T Pro-Am。
questions.story: The AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am began as the Bing Crosby National Pro-Amateur; AT&T became title sponsor in 1986, and the event is played at Pebble Beach Golf Links.
questions.storyZh: AT&T 圆石滩职业-业余配对赛前身为“克罗斯比职业-业余赛”，1986 年起由 AT&T 冠名，在圆石滩高尔夫林克斯举行。

questions.prompt: This island’s Ocean Course hosted the 1991 Ryder Cup and the 2012 PGA Championship.
questions.promptZh: 这座岛屿的海洋球场举办了 1991 年莱德杯和 2012 年 PGA 锦标赛。
questions.story: Kiawah Island’s Ocean Course staged the 1991 Ryder Cup and its first major, the 2012 PGA Championship, which Rory McIlroy won by eight strokes.
questions.storyZh: 基洼岛的海洋球场承办了 1991 年莱德杯，并在 2012 年迎来首场大满贯——PGA 锦标赛，麦克罗伊以 8 杆优势夺冠。

questions.prompt: This North Carolina town’s No. 2 course has hosted the U.S. Open four times.
questions.promptZh: 这座北卡罗来纳小镇的 2 号球场已四次承办美国公开赛。
questions.story: Pinehurst No. 2 has hosted the U.S. Open in 1999, 2005, 2014 and 2024, with more editions scheduled starting in 2029.
questions.storyZh: 松树丛 2 号球场先后于 1999、2005、2014、2024 年承办美国公开赛，2029 年起还有更多届次。

questions.prompt: This Arizona town lends its name to a golf resort near Scottsdale with two 18-hole courses
questions.promptZh: 这座亚利桑那小镇的名字被用于斯科茨代尔附近一处拥有两个18洞球场的高尔夫度假村
questions.story: Troon North and Troon South are golf courses in Scottsdale, Arizona, named after Troon, Scotland; the Phoenix Open is played at TPC Scottsdale.
questions.storyZh: 北特伦和南特伦是亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔的高尔夫球场，名字源自苏格兰特伦；凤凰城公开赛在TPC斯科茨代尔举行。

questions.prompt: Point here, where the local golf course has hosted the PGA Championship six times.
questions.promptZh: PGA锦标赛曾六次在这里举办。
questions.story: Jack Nicklaus won the PGA Championship here in 1998 and 2008.
questions.storyZh: 杰克·尼克劳斯曾于1998年和2008年在这里赢得PGA锦标赛。

questions.prompt: Point to this town, whose links hosted the Open Championship in 1999 and 2018
questions.promptZh: 指向这个小镇，其林克斯球场曾在 1999 年和 2018 年举办英国公开赛
questions.story: Carnoustie Golf Links in Scotland has hosted The Open Championship multiple times, including 1999 (Paul Lawrie won in a playoff) and 2018 (Francesco Molinari won). Tommy Armour won the first Open held there in 1931.
questions.storyZh: 苏格兰卡努斯蒂高尔夫林克斯多次举办英国公开赛，包括 1999 年（保罗·劳里附加赛胜出）和 2018 年（弗朗切斯科·莫利纳里夺冠）。汤米·阿莫于 1931 年赢得了在此举办的首届公开赛。

questions.prompt: Point to this Scottish town, whose golf club staged the very first Open Championship in 1860
questions.promptZh: 指向这座苏格兰小镇，当地高尔夫俱乐部于1860年举办了首届英国公开赛
questions.story: The Open Championship was first played at Prestwick Golf Club in 1860; the event returned there 24 times through 1925.
questions.storyZh: 英国公开赛于1860年首次在普雷斯特维克高尔夫俱乐部举行，此后至1925年共24次回到这里举办。

questions.prompt: This Scottish town's links course has hosted The Open ten times, most recently in 2024
questions.promptZh: 这座苏格兰小镇的林克斯球场已十次举办英国公开赛，最近一次是2024年
questions.story: Royal Troon's Old Course has hosted The Open ten times since 1923, most recently in 2024.
questions.storyZh: 皇家特伦老球场自1923年起已十次举办英国公开赛，最近一次在2024年。

questions.prompt: This town hosted the 2019 Open Championship, returning the major after its 1951 edition
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇举办了 2019 年英国公开赛，距上次举办 1951 年已过去多年
questions.story: Royal Portrush in Northern Ireland hosted The Open in 2019, when Shane Lowry won his first major. The club had previously staged the championship in 1951, when Max Faulkner won.
questions.storyZh: 北爱尔兰皇家波特拉什球场 2019 年承办英国公开赛，肖恩·劳里在此夺得个人首个大满贯。该球场上次举办是 1951 年，马克斯·福克纳夺冠。

questions.prompt: This town hosted the 1966 and 1971 Open Championships at its celebrated seaside links.
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇曾举办1966年及1971年的英国公开赛。
questions.story: Ballybunion's Old Course was originally designed by William Herd and later modified by Harry Colt.
questions.storyZh: 巴利布尼恩老球场最初由威廉·赫德设计，后来由哈里·科尔特进行了改造。

questions.prompt: A William F. Davis-designed course in this Rhode Island town was redesigned by Donald Ross in 1938
questions.promptZh: 这座罗德岛小镇上由威廉·F·戴维斯设计的球场，1938年由唐纳德·罗斯重新设计
questions.story: Rhode Island Country Club in Westerly was designed by William F. Davis, with Donald Ross overseeing changes to the course in 1938.
questions.storyZh: 位于韦斯特利的罗德岛乡村俱乐部由威廉·F·戴维斯设计，1938年由唐纳德·罗斯主持改造。

questions.prompt: This town's course hosted five U.S. Opens from 2002 through 2019.
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇的球场曾五次承办美国公开赛，末次在2019年。
questions.story: Bethpage State Park contains five courses, and Tiger Woods won the 2002 U.S. Open on the Black Course at age 24.
questions.storyZh: 贝斯佩奇州立公园拥有五座球场，24岁的泰格·伍兹曾在其中的黑球场赢得2002年美国公开赛。

questions.prompt: This town's course hosted the 2003 U.S. Open, won by Jim Furyk.
questions.promptZh: 这座小镇的球场承办了 2003 年美国公开赛，冠军是吉姆·福瑞克。
questions.story: Jim Furyk won his only major championship at the 2003 U.S. Open, held on the North Course of Olympia Fields Country Club, three shots clear of runner-up Stephen Leaney.
questions.storyZh: 2003 年美国公开赛在奥林匹亚菲尔兹乡村俱乐部北球场举行，吉姆·福瑞克以 3 杆优势夺冠，拿下他职业生涯唯一的大满贯。

questions.prompt: The course that hosted the 1999, 2008 and 2016 US Opens is located here in Minnesota.
questions.promptZh: 明尼苏达州这座城市的球场举办过三届美国公开赛。
questions.story: Hazeltine National Golf Club opened in 1962 and was designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr.
questions.storyZh: 黑泽尔廷国家高尔夫俱乐部于1962年开放，由罗伯特·特伦特·琼斯一世设计。

questions.prompt: This Long Island course staged the second U.S. Open in 1896
questions.promptZh: 这座长岛球场于 1896 年举办了第二届美国公开赛
questions.story: Shinnecock Hills hosted the second U.S. Open in 1896, won by James Foulis. The first U.S. Open had been played a year earlier in Newport, Rhode Island.
questions.storyZh: 辛尼科克山高尔夫俱乐部于 1896 年举办第二届美国公开赛，詹姆斯·福利斯夺冠。首届赛事于一年前在罗德岛纽波特举行。

questions.prompt: The 1998 US Open was played here on a course on this Massachusetts island.
questions.promptZh: 马萨诸塞州这座海岛的球场曾举办1998年美国公开赛。
questions.story: The Martha's Vineyard Golf Club's current course was redesigned by Donald Ross in 1924.
questions.storyZh: 玛莎葡萄园高尔夫俱乐部的现有球场由唐纳德·罗斯于1924年重新设计。

questions.prompt: This Florida city’s Biltmore course hosted a PGA Tour event in 1931-37 and again in 1959-62.
questions.promptZh: 这座佛罗里达城市的比尔特莫尔球场在 1931-37 年和 1959-62 年举办过 PGA 巡回赛赛事。
questions.story: The Coral Gables Open Invitational — also known as the Miami Biltmore Open — was played on the PGA Tour at the Miami Biltmore Golf Course in Coral Gables in 1931–37 and 1959–62.
questions.storyZh: 科勒尔盖布尔斯公开赛（又名迈阿密比尔特莫尔公开赛）1931-37 年和 1959-62 年在科勒尔盖布尔斯的迈阿密比尔特莫尔高尔夫球场作为 PGA 巡回赛的一站举行。

questions.prompt: This Florida city’s country club hosted the Sara Bay Classic, a Symetra Tour event, from 2012 to 2017.
questions.promptZh: 这座佛罗里达城市的乡村俱乐部在 2012 至 2017 年举办 Symetra 巡回赛萨拉湾精英赛。
questions.story: The Sara Bay Classic on the LPGA’s Symetra Tour was held at Sara Bay Country Club in Sarasota from 2012 to 2017.
questions.storyZh: LPGA 发展巡回赛（Symetra Tour）的萨拉湾精英赛 2012 至 2017 年在萨拉索塔的萨拉湾乡村俱乐部举行。

questions.prompt: Tiger Woods won the 1999 PGA Grand Slam of Golf at Poipu Bay on this Hawaiian island
questions.promptZh: 老虎·伍兹在1999年PGA球手大满贯赛上于这座夏威夷岛屿的Poipu Bay赢得冠军
questions.story: Tiger Woods won the 1999 PGA Grand Slam of Golf at Poipu Bay Golf Course on the Hawaiian island of Kauai. The event was staged at Poipu Bay every year from 1994 to 2006.
questions.storyZh: 老虎·伍兹在1999年PGA球手大满贯赛上于夏威夷可爱岛的Poipu Bay高尔夫球场夺冠。1994至2006年间该赛事一直在Poipu Bay举办。

sources.title: Wikipedia: PGA Grand Slam of Golf

questions.prompt: This Australian suburb is home to the golf club that hosted the 2006 Presidents Cup
questions.promptZh: 2006年总统杯举办的高尔夫俱乐部位于这个澳大利亚郊区
questions.story: The 2006 Presidents Cup was played at the Royal Melbourne Golf Club in Black Rock, a suburb of Melbourne, where the United States beat the International team.
questions.storyZh: 2006年总统杯在墨尔本郊区 Black Rock 的皇家墨尔本高尔夫俱乐部举行，美国队击败国际队夺冠。

questions.prompt: This Australian course hosted the 1998, 2011 and 2019 Presidents Cups
questions.promptZh: 这座澳大利亚球场举办过1998、2011和2019年总统杯
questions.story: Royal Melbourne hosted the Presidents Cup in 1998, 2011 and 2019; the International team won in 1998, their only victory in the event.
questions.storyZh: 皇家墨尔本球场举办过1998、2011和2019年总统杯；国际队1998年在此夺冠，这是他们在该赛事的唯一胜利。

questions.prompt: This Scottish links has co-hosted the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship since 2001 alongside St Andrews and Carnoustie
questions.promptZh: 这片苏格兰林克斯球场自2001年起与圣安德鲁斯、卡诺斯蒂共同举办邓希尔林克斯锦标赛
questions.story: Kingsbarns Golf Links has co-hosted the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship since 2001, alongside the Old Course at St Andrews and Carnoustie.
questions.storyZh: 金斯巴恩斯高尔夫林克斯自2001年起与圣安德鲁斯老球场、卡诺斯蒂共同举办邓希尔林克斯锦标赛。

questions.prompt: The famous links course in this Scottish town is ranked No. 2 among courses outside the United States.
questions.promptZh: 这座苏格兰林克斯小镇的著名球场被列为美国以外第二佳球场。
questions.story: Royal Dornoch’s Championship Course was ranked No. 2 on Golf Digest’s Top 100 International courses; the club has never hosted a modern professional tournament.
questions.storyZh: 皇家多诺赫的锦标赛球场在《高尔夫文摘》国际百佳球场榜上排名第二；该俱乐部从未举办过现代职业赛事。

questions.prompt: This Irish links course was designed by Donald Trump's golf company and opened in 2007
questions.promptZh: 这座爱尔兰林克斯球场由特朗普的高尔夫公司设计，2007年开业
questions.story: Trump International Golf Links & Hotel Ireland at Doonbeg opened in 2007; its links course was designed by Donald Trump's golf company.
questions.storyZh: 位于杜恩贝格的特朗普国际高尔夫球场及酒店于2007年开业，林克斯球场由特朗普的高尔夫公司设计。

questions.prompt: Tiger Woods hosts the Hero World Challenge each December at a resort near this Bahamian capital.
questions.promptZh: 老虎·伍兹每年十二月在这座巴哈马首都附近的度假区主办英雄世界挑战赛。
questions.story: The Hero World Challenge, hosted by Tiger Woods, has been played at the Albany development in the Bahamas each December since 2015.
questions.storyZh: 英雄世界挑战赛由老虎·伍兹主办，2015 年起每年十二月在巴哈马的奥尔巴尼度假区举行。

questions.prompt: This city-state is home to one of Asia's oldest professional golf tournaments, first played in 1961
questions.promptZh: 这座城市国家是亚洲最古老职业高尔夫赛事之一的所在地，该赛事始于 1961 年
questions.story: The Singapore Open was first played in 1961 and is the country's flagship golf tournament. Major champions Angel Cabrera, Adam Scott and Sergio Garcia are among its past winners.
questions.storyZh: 新加坡公开赛创办于1961年，是该国的旗舰高尔夫赛事，历届冠军包括大满贯得主安赫尔·卡布雷拉、亚当·斯科特和塞尔希奥·加西亚。

questions.prompt: This Chinese city’s Mission Hills resort is accredited as the world’s largest golf facility.
questions.promptZh: 这座中国城市的观澜湖度假区被认证为世界上最大的高尔夫设施。
questions.story: Mission Hills Shenzhen in Guanlan holds the Guinness record as the world’s largest golf facility, with twelve 18-hole courses; it hosted the World Cup of Golf in 2007, 2008 and 2009, won by Scotland, Sweden and Italy.
questions.storyZh: 深圳观澜的观澜湖以 12 座 18 洞球场获吉尼斯认证为世界最大高尔夫设施；2007、2008、2009 年高尔夫世界杯在此举行，冠军分别是苏格兰、瑞典和意大利。

questions.prompt: This town's seaside golf course hosted the 2005 Japan Open Golf Championship, won by Shingo Katayama.
questions.promptZh: 这座海滨小镇的高尔夫球场承办了 2005 年日本高尔夫公开赛，冠军是片山晋吴。
questions.story: Hirono Golf Club hosted the Japan Open Golf Championship in 2005, when Shingo Katayama won by two strokes; the course has hosted the national open five times.
questions.storyZh: 广野高尔夫俱乐部 2005 年承办日本高尔夫公开赛，片山晋吴以 2 杆优势夺冠；该球场共五次承办这项日本国家级公开赛。

questions.prompt: This western Alpine town’s course hosted the European Tour’s national open from 2015 to 2024.
questions.promptZh: 这个阿尔卑斯小镇的球场曾承办欧洲巡回赛本土公开赛。
questions.story: The Austrian Open was staged at Golfclub Dornbirn from 2015 through 2024. Martin Schläff won the 2015 event.
questions.storyZh: 奥地利公开赛于2015年至2024年在多恩比恩高尔夫俱乐部举行。马丁·施莱夫赢得了2015年赛事。

questions.prompt: This Paris suburb's course hosted the 2018 Ryder Cup, won by Team Europe
questions.promptZh: 这座巴黎近郊的球场举办了2018年莱德杯，欧洲队获胜
questions.story: Le Golf National in Guyancourt, southwest of Paris, hosted the 2018 Ryder Cup; Europe beat the United States 17½–10½.
questions.storyZh: 位于巴黎西南郊吉扬库尔的法国国家高尔夫俱乐部举办了2018年莱德杯，欧洲队以17.5比10.5击败美国队。

questions.prompt: This Wisconsin course hosted the PGA Championship in 2004 and 2010 and the 2021 Ryder Cup
questions.promptZh: 这座威斯康星州球场2004和2010年举办PGA锦标赛，2021年举办莱德杯
questions.story: Whistling Straits hosted the PGA Championship in 2004 and 2010; the United States won the 2021 Ryder Cup there 19–9.
questions.storyZh: 呼啸海峡球场2004和2010年举办PGA锦标赛；2021年莱德杯在此举行，美国队19比9获胜。

questions.prompt: This upstate New York club hosted the PGA Championship in 2003, 2013 and 2022.
questions.promptZh: 这座纽约州北部的俱乐部举办了 2003、2013 和 2022 年 PGA 锦标赛。
questions.story: Oak Hill Country Club in Pittsford, near Rochester, has hosted multiple majors, including the PGA Championship in 2003, 2013 and 2022.
questions.storyZh: 罗切斯特附近的匹茨福德橡树山乡村俱乐部多次承办大满贯，包括 2003、2013 和 2022 年 PGA 锦标赛。

questions.prompt: Before 2021, this club had hosted five editions of the US Open.
questions.promptZh: 这家俱乐部曾举办五届美国公开赛。
questions.story: The club staged its sixth U.S. Open in 2021, five years after its previous championship in 1995.
questions.storyZh: 该俱乐部于2021年举办了第六届美国公开赛，前五届中的最近一届是在1995年。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the tennis calendar's first Grand Slam of the year.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办每年首项网球大满贯赛事。
questions.story: The Australian Open was first played in 1905 and has been held at Melbourne Park since 1988.
questions.storyZh: 澳大利亚网球公开赛于1905年首次举办，自1988年以来一直在墨尔本公园举行。

questions.prompt: This city hosts tennis's oldest major, which has been played on grass since 1877.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市的大满贯自1877年起一直在草地上进行。
questions.story: The women's singles championship was first contested in 1884.
questions.storyZh: 女子单打锦标赛于1884年首次开赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosts one of the four tennis majors, played entirely on clay.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办一项全程在红土上进行的网球大满贯。
questions.story: The tournament's modern incarnation began in 1891, when it was known as the French Championships.
questions.storyZh: 这项赛事的现代形式始于1891年，当时称为法国锦标赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosts the final tennis Grand Slam of the calendar year.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办每年最后一项网球大满贯赛事。
questions.story: The US Open moved to its current home at Flushing Meadows in 1978.
questions.storyZh: 美国网球公开赛于1978年迁至今日的法拉盛赛场。

questions.prompt: This city hosts a prestigious Masters 1000 tennis tournament played on clay in spring.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市每年举办春季红土场的1000分大师赛网球赛。
questions.story: The 2022 Madrid Open concluded with Carlos Alcaraz defeating Alexander Zverev 6–3, 6–1 in the final at the Caja Mágica.
questions.storyZh: 2022年马德里公开赛决赛，卡洛斯·阿尔卡拉斯在魔力盒球场以6比3、6比1击败亚历山大·兹维列夫夺冠。

questions.prompt: This city hosts a spring clay-court Masters 1000 tournament staged at its historic national tennis complex.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市在国家网球中心举办红土场1000分大师赛。
questions.story: The tournament has been held at the Foro Italico since 2009.
questions.storyZh: 该赛事自2009年起一直在福尔意大利科举行。

questions.prompt: This city is one of two homes of the National Bank Open, the second-oldest tennis tournament in the world after Wimbledon.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市是国家银行公开赛的两个举办地之一，该赛事是温网之外历史第二悠久的网球赛事。
questions.story: The Canadian Open — now the National Bank Open — alternates annually between Toronto and Montreal and is the second-oldest active tennis tournament in the world after Wimbledon.
questions.storyZh: 加拿大公开赛（现名国家银行公开赛）每年在多伦多和蒙特利尔之间轮换举办，是温网之外历史第二悠久的现役网球赛事。

questions.prompt: This Quebec city's IGA Stadium shares the Canadian Open — the world's second-oldest tennis tournament — with Toronto
questions.promptZh: 这座魁北克城市的IGA球场与多伦多轮流举办加拿大网球公开赛——世界第二古老的网球赛事
questions.story: First played in 1881, the Canadian Open is the second-oldest tennis tournament in the world after Wimbledon; it now alternates between Montreal's IGA Stadium and Toronto's Sobeys Stadium.
questions.storyZh: 加拿大网球公开赛创办于1881年，是仅次于温网的世界第二古老网球赛事，现由蒙特利尔IGA球场与多伦多Sobeys球场轮流承办。

questions.prompt: This Ohio city gives its name to a summer Masters 1000 tennis tournament first played in 1899
questions.promptZh: 一项始于1899年的夏季1000分网球大师赛以这座俄亥俄州城市命名
questions.story: First played in 1899, the Cincinnati Open is the oldest tennis tournament in the United States still played near its original city; Roger Federer holds the record with seven singles titles.
questions.storyZh: 辛辛那提公开赛创办于1899年，是美国历史最悠久且仍在原址附近举办的网球赛事；费德勒以7个单打冠军保持赛会纪录。

questions.prompt: This city hosts an autumn Masters 1000 tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市每年举办秋季室外硬地场的1000分大师赛。
questions.story: First held in 2009 at the Qizhong Forest Sports City Arena, the Shanghai Masters is the only ATP Masters 1000 event outside Europe and North America.
questions.storyZh: 上海大师赛2009年首次举办，比赛地为旗忠森林体育城网球中心，是ATP唯一设在欧洲和北美之外的1000分大师赛。

questions.prompt: This capital has hosted an ATP 1000 event since 2002 — on hard courts until 2008, then on clay.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都自 2002 年起举办 ATP 1000 赛事——2008 年前为硬地，此后改为红土。
questions.story: The Madrid Open has been an ATP 1000 tournament since 2002, moving from hard courts to red clay in 2009 at the Caja Mágica.
questions.storyZh: 马德里公开赛自 2002 年起为 ATP 1000 赛事，2009 年迁至魔盒球场并改为红土。

questions.prompt: This capital is the birthplace of Novak Djokovic, winner of a record 24 Grand Slam singles titles.
questions.promptZh: 这座首都是诺瓦克·德约科维奇的出生地——他保持着 24 座大满贯单打冠军的纪录。
questions.story: Novak Djokovic was born in Belgrade in 1987 and has won a record 24 Grand Slam singles titles.
questions.storyZh: 诺瓦克·德约科维奇 1987 年出生于贝尔格莱德，保持着 24 座大满贯单打冠军的纪录。

questions.prompt: This Serbian city is home to FK Vojvodina, founded in 1914 and champions of Yugoslavia in 1966 and 1989
questions.promptZh: 这座塞尔维亚城市是伏伊伏丁那足球俱乐部的主场，该队成立于1914年，曾于1966年和1989年夺得南斯拉夫联赛冠军
questions.story: FK Vojvodina was founded in Novi Sad in 1914 and won the Yugoslav First League twice, in 1966 and 1989.
questions.storyZh: 伏伊伏丁那俱乐部1914年成立于诺维萨德，曾于1966年和1989年两夺南斯拉夫甲级联赛冠军。

questions.prompt: This Italian city hosted the season-ending ATP Finals for five consecutive editions, from 2021 through 2025
questions.promptZh: 这座意大利城市在2021至2025年连续五届举办ATP年终总决赛
questions.story: Turin took over the ATP Finals from London's O2 Arena, hosting the season-ending championship from 2021 through 2025.
questions.storyZh: 都灵从伦敦O2体育馆手中接过ATP年终总决赛举办权，2021至2025年连续承办这一赛季收官战。

questions.prompt: This British capital hosts the season-ending ATP Finals inside the O2 Arena, the tournament's home since 2011.
questions.promptZh: 这座英国首都的O2体育馆自2011年起承办ATP年终总决赛。
questions.story: The O2 Arena staged the ATP Finals in 2011, 2012 and 2013 before the tournament moved on to Shanghai.
questions.storyZh: O2体育馆在2011至2013年举办ATP总决赛，之后赛事移师上海。

questions.prompt: Roger Federer holds the record with ten singles titles at this Swiss city's indoor tournament, created in 1970
questions.promptZh: 罗杰·费德勒在这座瑞士城市的室内网球赛（创办于1970年）十夺单打冠军，保持赛会纪录
questions.story: The Swiss Indoors, created in 1970, has been played at the St. Jakobshalle since 1995; Basel native Roger Federer holds the record with ten singles titles.
questions.storyZh: 瑞士室内赛创办于1970年，自1995年起在圣雅各布会堂举行；巴塞尔本地名将费德勒以10个单打冠军保持赛会纪录。

questions.prompt: This city hosts Germany's oldest tennis tournament, first contested in 1892
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办德国历史最悠久的网球赛事，始创于1892年
questions.story: The Hamburg Open, first contested in 1892, is the fifth-oldest tennis tournament in the world; in 1993, world No. 1 Monica Seles was stabbed during a match at the Rothenbaum.
questions.storyZh: 汉堡公开赛创办于1892年，是世界上第五古老的网球赛事；1993年，时任世界第一的莫妮卡·塞莱斯在罗滕鲍姆球场的比赛期间遇刺。

questions.prompt: Roger Federer won this German town's grass-court tournament a record ten times
questions.promptZh: 罗杰·费德勒在这座德国小镇的草地网球赛十夺冠军，保持赛会纪录
questions.story: The Halle Open has been played on grass in Halle, Germany, since 1993; Roger Federer won the singles title a record ten times.
questions.storyZh: 哈雷公开赛自1993年起在德国哈雷的草地上举行；费德勒以10个单打冠军保持赛会纪录。

questions.prompt: In May 2025 the football club from this Italian city beat Milan 1–0 to win the Coppa Italia, its first major trophy since 1974
questions.promptZh: 2025年5月，这座意大利城市的足球俱乐部在意大利杯决赛中1比0击败AC米兰，夺得1974年以来的首座重要奖杯
questions.story: Bologna beat Milan 1–0 in the Coppa Italia final on 14 May 2025, the club's first major trophy since 1974; the season before, Bologna had returned to the Champions League after a 60-year absence.
questions.storyZh: 2025年5月14日，博洛尼亚在意大利杯决赛中1比0击败AC米兰，夺得1974年以来的首座重要奖杯；此前一个赛季，博洛尼亚时隔60年重返欧冠联赛。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the Summer Olympics in 1964 and again in 2020.
questions.promptZh: 这座城市分别在1964与2020年举办夏季奥运会。
questions.story: The 2020 Games were postponed by one year because of COVID-19, but retained their original name.
questions.storyZh: 2020年奥运会因新冠疫情推迟一年举行，但保留了原赛事名称。

questions.prompt: This city hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896, whose highlight was the first Olympic marathon
questions.promptZh: 这座城市举办了1896年首届现代奥运会，诞生了奥运史上第一场马拉松
questions.story: Athens hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896 at the Panathenaic Stadium, where Greek runner Spyridon Louis won the first Olympic marathon.
questions.storyZh: 1896年首届现代奥运会在雅典的帕那辛纳克体育场举行，希腊选手斯皮里宗·路易斯赢得奥运史上第一场马拉松。

questions.prompt: This Georgia city is where a Falcons receiver set the franchise single-season receiving yards record
questions.promptZh: 这座佐治亚州城市是一位猎鹰队外接手创造队史单赛季接球码纪录的地方
questions.story: Julio Jones set the Atlanta Falcons' single-season receiving record with 1,871 yards in 2015, surpassing Roddy White, who spent his entire 11-season career with the Falcons.
questions.storyZh: 朱利奥·琼斯在2015年以1871码创造亚特兰大猎鹰队史单赛季接球纪录，超越了效力球队11个赛季的罗迪·怀特。
